title: Senior Data Engineer- Data Bricks
description:
At Tennis Australia, we’re creating a more playful world through tennis – for everyone.

From grassroots to Grand Slams, tennis brings people together, inspires communities, and builds champions on and off the court.

We’re a team of imaginative and passionate people who believe in the power of sport to make a difference. If you're ready to help us serve up real impact, we’d love to hear from you.

We’re committed to reflecting the communities we work and play in. We strongly encourage applications from women, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, LGBTQI+ individuals, people with disability, and people from culturally diverse backgrounds.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer- Data Bricks to join our Technology team on a full‑time, permanent basis.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you’ll play a key part in designing and delivering scalable data integration, analytics and reporting solutions across our data platform. You’ll take ownership of data ingestion and processing, contribute to the evolution of our data architecture, and work hands‑on with modern cloud technologies to support a high‑quality data warehouse and analytics environment.

Working closely with engineers, analysts and business stakeholders, you’ll help build reusable data processing frameworks and architectural approaches that scale with the organisation’s data and analytics needs.

In this role you will:

  • Design, develop, and evolve modern data engineering solutions on Microsoft Azure, with a strong focus on Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory (ADF), and Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS).

  • Develop and maintain reliable, secure and high‑performing data pipelines.

  • Develop robust data transformations using PySpark, Databricks SQL, SQL, and Python.

  • Design, implement, and maintain curated analytical and dimensional data models aligned to TA BI, analytics, and AI requirements.

  • Manage data ingestion and onboarding of new data sources and partners

  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders.

  • Ensure ongoing data quality, reliability and performance across production data and analytics environments.

About you

To be successful in this role you will have:

  • Demonstrated senior‑level data engineering capability, delivering and supporting solutions in enterprise, production‑grade data and BI environments.

  • Strong hands‑on experience with Azure data technologies, including Databricks, Azure Data Factory and Azure DevOps, with the ability to implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines.

  • Proven capability to design and build scalable analytical data solutions, including data warehouses, lakehouse architectures and dimensional data models.

  • Advanced data engineering skills in SQL, Python, PySpark and Databricks SQL, with a strong focus on performance, reliability and data quality.

  • Confidence balancing project delivery and BAU/support, proactively identifying and resolving data quality, availability and performance issues in production environments.

  • Strong stakeholder engagement, leadership and communication skills, translating business requirements into robust and reliable technical solutions.

  • Ability to apply best practices across cloud security, access control, analytics architecture and data governance, contributing to standards, design reviews and continuous improvement.

  • Hold (or be willing to obtain) a current Police Check and Working with Children Check

  • Preparedness to be flexible in regard to working hours and arrangements relating to work associated with Tennis Australia

What’s to love?

  • Career development with a range of formal education and on the job training opportunities

  • Tickets to the Australian Open plus Superbox tickets to events at Rod Laver & Melbourne Arena

  • Monthly health & wellbeing activities with access to CorePlus Pilates

  • Onsite gym, tennis facilities & free onsite car parking

  • Salary packaging & a range of discounts from our sponsorship partners

  • Attractive leave benefits - with up to 26 weeks of paid parental leave for all primary caregivers and Sorry Business and Ceremonial Leave for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander employees

  • We are proud to be recognised as an employer of choice for women by WORK180

To Apply

If you think you’re up to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you! Please submit your resume and cover letter via our online application system. Please note, only applications submitted through our system will be considered.

If you need assistance or adjustments to fully participate in the application process, please contact recruit@Tennis.com.au.

Applications close the 9th of August; however we will be reviewing applications as they are received, therefore this role may close sooner if we find the right candidate.

Tennis Australia is committed to providing a safe environment for all tennis participants, including children and young people. It is essential everyone involved with delivering tennis in Australia understands their responsibility in relation to child-safety.

We believe playing makes life better and we are always on the lookout to talented people to join our team and help us create a playful world through tennis.

Even if we are not currently advertising the position that you are looking for today, we may be tomorrow. There are a number of ways that you can keep up-to-date with new opportunities as they happen.

We encourage you to create a profile and register for our job alerts, as well as follow Tennis Australia on LinkedIn to stay up to date on the latest news and opportunities.

Experience in data validation, reconciliation, data quality checks and troubleshooting. AWS experience, particularly S3 and Athena, is preferred. Familiarity with CSV/Parquet, IAM and data partitioning is advantageous. Experience with Tableau or other BI tools is an advantage. Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills. Able to work independently, manage priorities and collaborate with business users, technical teams, vendors and source system owners. Interest or experience in HR/workforce data is advantageous.

title: Part Time Key Holder
description:
Club Monaco is an international men’s and women’s lifestyle brand with a distinctly urban casual point of view, best defined as a play of opposites: mixing vintage with new, hard with soft and eclecticism with minimalism. Each season, Club Monaco offers customers must have fashion and key pieces that together are the foundation of a modern wardrobe.

Overview

A Keyholder will develop professional skills that will contribute to the financial growth of the company. He or she will be responsible to support the goals of the company and the individual store. A keyholder is expected to deliver on the company’s customer service expectations, operational and loss prevention procedures, and people development process. They will assist managers with their responsibilities in order to meet the standards and expectations of their roles, which may include merchandising, inventory or employee experience related functions.

Responsibilities

Customer Experience

  • Protect the customer experience in all areas
  • Help achieve clienteling and data capture goals in order to drive sales and maintain customer focus
  • Ensure daily monitoring and execution of sales
  • Provide a friendly and welcoming environment
  • Maintain a professional appearance consistent with established dress code and image guidelines
  • Maximize personal sales at all opportunities, including additional sales at cash wrap
  • Assist in conflict resolution with client issues
  • Communicate product and customer feedback to managers
  • Achieve personal SPH goals*

People

  • Support management team with training new associates on customer service standards and product knowledge
  • Supervise sales floor and provide direct supervision for an abbreviated period of time in the absence of a store manager on the floor
  • Supervise and develop sales associates as necessary

Operational Standards

  • Responsible for all opening/closing procedures of the store on all designated shifts as per the store hours of operation
  • Ensure strict compliance and adhering to the application of policies and procedure
  • Key Holders will be able to process returns, but cannot execute employee purchases
  • Assists the Management Team with inventory preparations and participate in the actual Inventory
  • Ensure operational integrity & asset protection compliance in day to day operations & practices

Visual Presentation/Store Maintenance

  • Actively participate in all merchandising activities including, but not limited to: daily stock maintenance and order, stock receiving and processing, product transfers, maintaining sales floor standards, and flips
  • Be knowledgeable of the store's merchandise, back of house and front of house layout

Skills and Requirements

  • Must have a minimum of 1-2 years of retail experience
  • Excellent interpersonal skills supporting a team environment
  • Strong English communication - verbal and written / Multilingual is a plus
  • Excellent time management/project skills
  • Strong planning and organizational skills with a sense of priority for deadlines and attention to detail
  • Ability to recognize and react to changing work demands
  • Comfortable and confident in making effective autonomous (and group) decisions in a timely manner
  • Goal oriented: ability to stay focused on creating winning results
  • Dedicated to high levels of Customer Service and Sales Productivity
  • On the job special projects that have developed depth of related experience an asset

Physical Demands:

  • Hours/days of work can be varied due to the demands of the business
  • Must be able to work shift standing and walking and able to lift approx. 20 lbs.
  • Must be able to pack, unpack and move stock when supporting in receiving / stocking store functions.

title: AVP, Data Engineer (Information Security & Digital Risk Management)
description:
Who We Are As Singapore's longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires. Today, we're on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia's leading financial services partner for a sustainable future. We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career. Your Opportunity Starts Here. Why Join Join OCBC's Group Information Security & Digital Risk Management team and contribute directly to strengthening the Bank's information risk monitoring, analytics and control capabilities. This full-time Data Engineer role is hands-on and delivery-focused: you will build secure, reliable data pipelines and data products that enable actionable risk insights across the Group. You will work with business, risk and technology stakeholders to transform structured and unstructured data into trusted, production-grade datasets and analytics solutions, while applying sound engineering practices in a regulated banking environment. How You Succeed You succeed by being a hands-on data engineering practitioner who can independently translate business and information risk requirements into robust, production-grade data engineering solutions. Success In This Role Requires Build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for batch and near-real-time data ingestion, transformation and delivery. Apply strong SQL, Python, Spark, Hadoop and data modelling skills to solve practical information risk and analytics problems. Use orchestration, scheduling and monitoring tools to ensure pipeline reliability, operational resilience and timely issue resolution. Collaborate clearly with risk, business, technology, production support and platform teams across requirements, UAT, deployment and warranty support.

What You Do Data Engineering Delivery Responsible for developing and enhancing data pipelines and system architecture. Create and maintain the optimal data pipeline to enable ingestion from a wide variety of structured and unstructured data sources via Talend. Define and understand business requirements to develop and implement solutions. Support development and deployment of applications utilising the data pipelines to provide actionable insights. Involve in UAT execution with a focus on strategic testing processes and procedures to ensure that business standards and specifications are met. Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements: automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery and cleansing/transformation. Collaborate with multiple stakeholders independently to drive key initiatives and projects.

Solutioning, Testing & Production Support Translate business and information risk requirements into technical specifications, data models, pipeline design and implementation plans. Support SIT, UAT, OAT and production verification, ensuring business standards, acceptance criteria and control expectations are met. Own technical delivery through deployment, production onboarding, warranty support and issue resolution. Maintain documentation for data lineage, transformation rules, operational procedures and support handover.

Information Security & Digital Risk Management Support data-driven information risk initiatives, including staff abnormal activity monitoring, control analytics, risk indicators and management dashboards. Embed secure-by-design and data governance practices into pipeline development, including access control, data handling, auditability and monitoring considerations. Contribute to risk governance, control enhancements and regulatory-aligned reporting through reliable data engineering outputs. Help convert information risk use cases into repeatable analytics assets, reusable data marts and sustainable operating processes.

Experience Who You Are Minimum 6 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, large-scale distributed data platforms, data warehousing, and analytics engineering. Experience in risk management and project management will be advantageous.

Technical Skills Strong background in traditional structured database environments such as Teradata / Oracle, SQL and PL/SQL. Fluent in the management of structured and unstructured data, as well as modern data transformation methodologies and tools such as DBT. Proficient in Hadoop ecosystem components, including HIVE, Impala, HDFS, Spark, Scala and HBase. Hands-on experience working on real-time data and streaming applications using Kafka or other similar tools. Hands-on experience in automation process, including building procedures, ETL and automated job scheduling using data integration tools such as Talend.

Information Risk Knowledge Good understanding of technology, information and data risk concepts. Awareness of data security controls, including access control, encryption, data handling, auditability and data governance. Familiarity with regulatory-aligned technology risk management, information security or operational risk reporting will be advantageous.

Competencies Hands-on, analytical and comfortable solving complex data problems independently. Strong attention to detail, with a reliability mindset for production-grade delivery. Able to communicate technical topics clearly to business, risk and technology stakeholders. Collaborative team player who can also take ownership and drive assigned deliverables end-to-end.

What We Offer Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

title: Commercial/Warranty Technician
description:
Job description:

WHO WE ARE

Crossville Heating and Cooling, Inc. is a family owned, rapidly growing home solutions company! We understand that our greatest asset is our team. We are on the search for top notch talent to join our phenomenal team. If you are looking to showcase your skills and be a part of a collaborative and professional team, Crossville Heating and Cooling, Inc. is the place for you!

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are always seeking candidates to join our team with the following qualities:

  • Loyal - Be a promoter and protector of the company in word and deed including social media, customer interaction, and interaction with co-workers.
  • Dependable - Be punctual, show good attendance, complete goals as expected, and take pride in quality work.
  • Motivated - Be eager to satisfy customers, complete job tasks, take on new challenges and processes, and show professional growth.
  • Professional - Be perceived in all ways professional including speech, dress, and driving in all settings.
  • Customer Priority - Be a customer activist. Our customers will always come first. Processes and feedback can always be altered, but make sure the customer is taken care of!

Pay Range: $30.00-$35.00 Per hour

Paid Weekly with payroll approval process to ensure accuracy on each paycheck

About the Role:

The HVAC-Warranty Technician plays a critical role in ensuring customer satisfaction by providing expert technical service for HVAC systems under warranty. This position requires a blend of technical proficiency and customer service skills to diagnose, repair, and maintain heating, ventilation, and air conditioning equipment while effectively communicating warranty coverage and service options to clients. The technician will be responsible for managing warranty claims, coordinating with manufacturers, and ensuring compliance with warranty terms to protect both the customer and the company. By delivering timely and high-quality service, the technician helps to extend the lifespan of HVAC systems and fosters long-term customer relationships. Ultimately, this role contributes to the company’s reputation for reliability and excellence in HVAC service and support across the United States.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Valid HVAC technician certification or license as required by state regulations.
  • Proven experience in HVAC system repair and maintenance, preferably with warranty service exposure.
  • Strong understanding of HVAC system components, diagnostics, and repair techniques.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • EPA Section 608 Certification for handling refrigerants.
  • Familiarity with warranty claim processing software and manufacturer protocols.
  • Additional technical training or certifications related to HVAC systems.
  • Ability to work flexible hours including weekends or emergency call-outs.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform diagnostic evaluations and repairs on HVAC systems covered under warranty to ensure optimal operation and customer satisfaction.
  • Provide clear and professional sales consultations regarding warranty coverage, service plans, and potential upgrades to customers.
  • Manage warranty claims by accurately documenting service activities, coordinating with manufacturers, and ensuring compliance with warranty policies.
  • Schedule and complete service calls efficiently while maintaining detailed records of work performed and parts used.
  • Educate customers on proper HVAC system maintenance and usage to prevent future issues and maximize system performance.

Skills:

The HVAC-Warranty Technician utilizes technical troubleshooting skills daily to diagnose and repair complex HVAC system issues efficiently. Strong communication skills are essential for explaining warranty terms and service options clearly to customers, ensuring transparency and trust. Organizational skills are applied when managing warranty claims and maintaining accurate service records, which helps streamline operations and manufacturer interactions. Additionally, problem-solving abilities enable the technician to adapt to diverse service challenges and deliver effective solutions that enhance customer satisfaction.

  • Company truck

  • Retirement plan

title: Backend Software Engineer (senior/staff)
description:
This role spans everything our customers touch: the integrations that turn raw vehicle telematics from 330+ providers into clean data, the public APIs enterprises build against, the dashboards they work in, and the ingestion platform underneath it all. It is a mix of product and backend engineering, shaping the APIs and deeper backend components our customers depend on. If you want to be three layers of abstraction from the customer, this isn't the role for you.

You'll own systems end-to-end and help shape the product, not just build it. Working closely with customers, you'll turn their problems into the right abstractions and reusable components that scale. Your judgment directly shapes how customers launch products on high-volume telematics data to benefit vehicles and fleets on the road every day.

What you'll do

  • Design new features and platform capabilities, partnering with teammates and customers to expand what Terminal can do.

  • Build the primitives that power our platform: connector frameworks, orchestration, monitoring, auth, testing, and more.

  • Shape how we build, not just what we build: the AI-powered tooling that lets the platform increasingly improve itself.

  • Add and maintain integrations across 330+ telematics providers, making messy, under-documented APIs reliable.

  • Work with integration partners to shape their APIs, expand the data we can offer, and improve performance at the source.

  • Work directly with customers: demos, implementations, and troubleshooting threads.

  • Work day to day in TypeScript/Node.js to deploy services on AWS.

What we're looking for

  • A strong backend engineer who's shipped and owned production systems end to end.

  • Can be trusted with hard architecture decisions.

  • Thrives against messy, undocumented, uncooperative external systems and makes them reliable anyway.

  • Depth in distributed systems: you anticipate failures and can debug fast when things break.

  • Platform builder: you make the systems other teams stand on, and design them to last.

  • Sound judgment in ambiguity: you scope before building and know when to go deep on details VS ship fast experiments.

  • Customer-facing: you want to be in the demo, the implementation call, and the hard troubleshooting thread so you can learn more about our customers.

  • Strong in Node.js and TypeScript, or confident to pick it up fast.

You don't need to check every box. If you're missing some but confident you'll close the gap quickly, apply anyway.

Nice to have

  • Serverless and event-driven architectures (Lambda, SQS, Kafka, EventBridge).

  • Orchestration and workflow engines (Step Functions, Temporal).

  • JVM languages for cross-team work with the data platform.

About Us

We were founded in 1918 as Young & Franklin Tool Works on Franklin Street in Syracuse, but we’ve come a long way since then! Our product lines are low volume, high mix, and very tight tolerances. We manufacture, assemble and test valves and actuators for the Aerospace and Power Generation markets. Our 120,000 square foot facility houses R&D, Design Engineering, Assembly & Test, and an 80,000 square foot Machining Operation. We regularly invest in new machines but recently outdid ourselves investing in 5 new machines in 18 months! We’re part of the TransDigm Group (NYSE: TDG), one of the world’s leading suppliers of highly engineered components for virtually all aerospace applications, helping us continually invest in new products and technology. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds who share in our enthusiasm for innovation, design, and manufacturing excellence.

Position Summary

Repair Technicians work as part of a team as well as independently. General responsibilities include completing repairs, modifications, overhauls, and tests on aircraft hydraulic/pneumatic components in accordance with Federal Aviation Regulation (FAR) Part 145 and Tactair Fluid Controls internal processes.

Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot, repair, overhaul or modify, and test hydraulic/pneumatic aircraft components.
  • Use test fixtures and hand tools to apply twisting (torque) force to loosen a variety of fasteners.
  • Communicate component status to Sales & Marketing for quote preparation.
  • Certify workmanship is accomplished in accordance with established federal and company guidelines.
  • Picks up, sweeps or removes any debris, residue or any excess foreign material located in or around a part, components or assembly as soon as physically possible after the operation takes place.
  • Maintains a clean uncluttered work area and takes precautions against the introduction of foreign objects into components and assemblies.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.

Education and Experience

  • This position requires either a US Person (as defined in applicable export regulations) or a non-US person who is eligible to obtain required export authorization.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, repair and test hydraulic/pneumatic components using charts, schematics, and blueprints and test procedures.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with all employees in a diverse, fast-paced and challenging technical environment.
  • Good mechanical aptitude is essential. Proficient with hand tools, precision measuring devices including calipers, micrometers, multimeters, and various gauges required.
  • Strong preference for Airframe and Powerplant (A&P) certification.
  • High School graduate, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Work overtime as necessary.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Individuals may need to sit or stand as needed. May require frequent walking primarily on a level surface. Reaching above shoulder heights, below the waist or lifting as required to move materials throughout the workday. Proper lifting techniques required. May include lifting up to 35 pounds. May include frequent pulling, pushing, and grasping.
  • The primary environment of this position is the manufacturing areas where under certain areas require the use of personal protective equipment such as safety glasses with side shields and mandatory hearing protection, and proper footwear.

title: Sr Director, Operations and Supply Chain
description:
About Us

Connected International, Inc. (Connected Cannabis Co.) is a leading vertically integrated cannabis company based in Sacramento and operating in California, Arizona, and Florida. With over 11 years experience, Connected specializes in breeding, growing, manufacturing, and distributing top-shelf cannabis through its state-of-the-art facilities and proprietary genetics.

With over 250 employees across the United States, Connected maintains a strong presence in the industry across multiple markets. The company has recently expanded into Arizona and Florida with ambitious national expansion plans underway. Connected's mission has always been to breed, grow, and sell the best cannabis in the world, setting high standards for its products, people, and partners wherever we go.

About the Job

The Sr Director, Operations is responsible for leading and optimizing the end-to-end California operating system, spanning supply planning, manufacturing, production, demand planning, distribution, order fulfillment, and fleet operations. This leader manages through its functional leaders while creating the accountability, operating cadence, and performance standards required to deliver high service levels, consistent quality, and efficient cost structures. While not responsible for cultivation, this leader must also understand cultivation outputs well enough to understand the timing, quality, and characteristics of incoming biomass and translate that supply into effective production and biomass pathway decisions.

Success in this role requires a strong understanding of customer needs, industry dynamics, operational best practices, and hands-on leadership to deliver measurable impact and longterm value across the organization. This position is based in the Sacramento, California area and requires daily onsite presence across facilities.

What You Will Do

  • Lead California Operations: Provide strategic and operational leadership across the operations network, including supply planning, manufacturing, production, packaging, warehousing, distribution, fulfillment, and fleet operations.
  • Own Supply & Production Planning: Lead integrated demand and supply planning/S&OP in conjunction with capacity planning, inventory strategy, and biomass allocation to align with commercial objectives while minimizing stockouts and aging inventory.
  • Drive Operational Accountability: Establish clear KPIs, targets, budgets, and operating rhythms across functional areas; regularly review performance, identify root causes, and drive timely corrective and preventive actions.
  • Build Best-in-Class Operations: Develop and maintain standardized operating procedures, efficient workflows and manufacturing layouts, disciplined inventory controls, and scalable operating systems that promote safety, quality, compliance, efficiency, and consistency.
  • Optimize Cost, Productivity & Performance: Continuously improve labor, material, freight, inventory, yield, cycle time, equipment utilization, and overall operating costs without compromising service, quality, or compliance.
  • Translate Cultivation Supply into Operations: Maintain visibility into cultivation forecasts, harvest timing, biomass quality, and expected volumes to proactively adjust production schedules, processing pathways, capacity, and inventory plans.
  • Lead Continuous Improvement & Capital Planning: Identify and execute opportunities in technology, equipment, automation, systems, process improvements, and facility capacity; develop business cases and lead capital planning and implementation to support growth and scalability.
  • Manage Suppliers & External Partners: Lead strategic vendor and service-provider relationships, including sourcing, negotiations, performance management, risk mitigation, issue resolution, and business reviews to ensure material availability, service levels, quality, and cost effectiveness.
  • Lead Quality, Safety & Compliance: Champion a culture of safety, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with applicable state, local, regulatory, and company quality requirements. Lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions for operational and quality issues.
  • Support Product Launches & Operational Transitions: Partner with Commercial, Cultivation, and other stakeholders to translate product and technology roadmaps into operational requirements and successfully execute product launches, new product introduction, process changes, and transitions to scaled production.
  • Build Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Cultivation, Sales, Commercial, Finance, Compliance, R&D, and other stakeholders to align operating plans, resources, and priorities with business objectives and customer commitments.
  • Develop High-Performing Teams: Lead, recruit, mentor, and develop functional leaders and operations teams; establish clear ownership and accountability, strengthen leadership capability and succession planning, and foster a data-driven culture of continuous improvement.
  • Manage Financial & Operational Reporting: Own operating budgets, forecasts, cost-control initiatives, and performance reporting; provide timely analysis and recommendations to management to support informed business decisions.

Supervisory Responsibilities: This position provides leadership and oversight for the Operations Department and is responsible for organizational structure, performance management, hiring, development, and accountability of Operations team members.

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in multi-facility manufacturing industries.
  • Proven ability to lead large, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Hands on ERP experience, critical
  • Experience with continuous improvement methodologies and operational excellence programs.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong financial acumen with experience in budgeting and P&L management.
  • Ability to travel ~25% of time - regular monthly travel, required.

    Compensation Description (annually): The salary range for this position in the selected city is $150,000.00 - $200,000.00 annually.

    Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location.

Physical Requirements/Workplace Environment

  • Requires normal, corrective vision range, the ability to see color and the ability to distinguish letters, numbers and symbols.
  • Requires normal hearing range.
  • Workplace is a hybrid office setting with frequent travel

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Why Connected?

Connected is an exciting and innovative workplace with a highly engaged workforce brought together by a shared passion to be the best in the business. We are on a mission to breed, grow and sell the best cannabis in the world! This is a super unique opportunity to be part of the start-up stage of the booming cannabis industry. We are looking for exceptional people to join our team as we transition into the next phase of our business ventures and become a leader in the cannabis space.

About Fisica Inc.

Fisica, Inc. is a premier manufacturer of advanced defense products, specializing in the design and production of airborne and ground-based antennas, as well as cutting-edge electromagnetic systems and simulators. Headquartered in San Leandro, California, with additional operations in Simi Valley, Fisica plays a vital role as a trusted partner to leading defense primes and the U.S. Department of Defense.

Our company operates as - ATI, Randtron, Datron and Space Vector—each bringing deep expertise and innovation to the defense sector. Led by a seasoned management team, Fisica is committed to excellence in engineering, manufacturing, and mission-critical solutions that enhance national security.

At Fisica, we foster a strong, collaborative work culture that values individual contributions and empowers our employees. Our commitment to innovation, integrity, and teamwork makes us a leader in the defense industry and an exceptional place to build a career.

Position Summary:
Responsible for performing moderately complex electro-mechanical assembly tasks related to the manufacture of small antennas and re­lated subassemblies.

Responsibilities:

  • Performs electrical and mechanical assembly work utilizing blueprints and operation sheets.
  • Uses standard hand tools and various epoxies to perform operations.
  • Perform work with microscopes for lengthy periods of time.
  • Interfaces with quality assurance and test personnel to ensure sub­assemblies are inspected and tested at specified checkpoints.
  • Performs hand soldering, wiring, and assembling small complex components.
  • Performs rework and repairs as required.
  • Performs limited, intermittent physical exertion. Works under ac­ceptable conditions with some distraction due to occasional ex­posure to noise, dust, heat, or chemicals.
  • Flexible working varied shifts, overtime and weekends.
  • Must have good repetitive manual dexterity with both hands.
  • Must have sufficient vision to see relative positions of small parts and able to discern symmetry and proper alignment.
  • Will be exposed to some or all the following: fumes, dust, toxic or caustic chemicals, outdoor weather, moving mechanical parts and moderate to loud noise levels.
  • Able to stoop, bend, kneel, and squat for extended periods of time.
  • Able to push and reach for extended periods of time.
  • Able to lift 25 pounds close to the body repetitively. (Employees need to ask for assistance and use material handling tools for less weight in awkward location and/or body positions and for any items over 25 pounds).
  • Must wear appropriate personal protective equipment as necessary.
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a future Security Clearance is required for the role. Eligibility requires U.S. citizenship.

Qualifications:

  • Requires a high school diploma and/or a minimum of five to nine years of related electro-mechanical assembly experience.
  • The ability to read operation sheets and moderately complex blueprints.
  • Requires soldering skills, knowledge of electronic components and color codes, the ability to use measuring instruments such as caliper and scale and use formulas.
  • Ability to pass IPC J-STD-001.

title: Senior Analyst, Data Governance
description:
Journey with us! Combine your career goals and sense of adventure by joining our exciting team of employees. Royal Caribbean Group is pleased to offer competitive compensation and benefits package, and excellent career development opportunities, each offering unique ways to explore the world.


The Royal Caribbean Group’s HR Transformation Team has an exciting career opportunity for a full-time Sr. Analyst, HR System Design reporting to the Sr. Manager, HR System Design.


The position is onsite and based in Mexico City, Mexico

SUMMARY

The Sr. Analyst, HR System Design, is a technical HR Systems professional responsible for the hands-on administration, configuration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of HR technology platforms, including SAP SuccessFactors and custom system applications.

This role serves as a key technical resource within the HR Transformation organization, partnering with HR, IT, and business stakeholders to configure solutions, support system enhancements, execute testing activities, manage releases, and maintain system functionality. The Lead ensures HR applications operate effectively, remain aligned with business requirements, and deliver a high-quality user experience.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Reporting to the Sr. Manager, HR System Design, this role is responsible for supporting designated products within the HR ecosystem and executing activities associated with the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

Product Administration & Configuration

  • Perform hands-on configuration and maintenance of HR platforms, including SAP SuccessFactors, custom applications, and related HR systems.
  • Configure business rules, workflows, security roles, permissions, fields, page layouts, templates, and system settings based on approved business requirements.
  • Support implementation of new system functionality, enhancements, integrations, and releases.
  • Troubleshoot system issues and identify root causes in partnership with technical and business teams.
  • Execute platform updates and configuration changes in accordance with established governance processes.
  • Maintain system documentation, configuration workbooks, and technical specifications.
  • Support data integrity, system usability, and process standardization across HR applications.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for assigned HR technology platforms.
  • Strong Configuration Capability in the core applications.

Backlog & Requirements Execution

  • Support intake activities and document enhancement requests, defects, and operational support needs.
  • Translate approved business requirements into detailed system configuration and technical specifications.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to clarify requirements and assess solution feasibility.
  • Maintain backlog items, support prioritization discussions, and provide effort estimates for configuration activities.
  • Ensure requirements are accurately reflected within system designs and configurations.

SDLC Support & Testing

  • Execute SDLC activities including requirements validation, configuration, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Develop and execute unit testing, system testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing scenarios.
  • Document test results, identify defects, and coordinate resolution activities.
  • Support release management activities and production deployments.
  • Validate delivered solutions meet business requirements and quality standards.
  • Ensure compliance with established SDLC processes, standards, and controls.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture teams to ensure solutions are technically sound and future-ready


Stakeholder Collaboration & User Support

  • Partner with HR Centers of Excellence, HR Operations, IT teams, and business stakeholders to support system enhancements and ongoing operations.
  • Provide technical guidance regarding system capabilities, configuration options, and best practices.
  • Assist in evaluating new platform features and identifying opportunities for process improvement.
  • Develop job aids, configuration documentation, knowledge articles, and training materials.
  • Support organizational readiness activities associated with new system functionality.
  • Develop job aids / training materials to provide guidance on new enhancements to the HR Applications.


Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor production environments and proactively identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Analyze recurring issues and implement sustainable configuration-based solutions.
  • Support audit requests, compliance activities, and data quality initiatives.
  • Assist with integration validation and downstream system impacts related to configuration changes.
  • Participate in periodic platform reviews, release assessments, and enhancement planning activities.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging HR technology capabilities and SuccessFactors releases relevant to assigned areas.
  • Identify and escalate risks, dependencies, and delivery constraints
  • Ensure delivery to scope and timeline


QUALIFICATIONS, KNOWLEDGE, AND SKILLS

  • 4+ years of experience supporting HR technology, HRIS platforms, or enterprise applications.
  • 2+ years of hands-on configuration and administration experience of SAP SuccessFactors or Custom Applications.
  • Experience configuring and supporting one or more SuccessFactors modules (Employee Central, Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance & Goals, Compensation, Learning, Succession, etc.).
  • Experience supporting integrated ecosystems involving SAP SuccessFactors, Salesforce, ServiceNow, or related enterprise applications.
  • Strong understanding of HR processes and HR technology solutions.
  • Experience supporting system enhancements, releases, testing, and defect resolution.
  • Familiarity with Agile and traditional SDLC methodologies.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into system configurations and technical solutions.
  • Experience developing test scripts, executing testing, and supporting production deployments.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Knowledge of security roles, permissions, workflows, and data management concepts.
  • Experience creating technical documentation, job aids, and system support materials.
  • SAP SuccessFactors certifications preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and execution discipline.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Customer-focused with a commitment to service excellence.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across functional and technical teams.

Geospatial Cloud Analytics (GCA) is a leader in AV, VTC, and Unified Communications services, delivering exceptional support and system solutions to federal clients. Our mission is to advance AV technologies to improve communication and operational efficiency for our clients. We are looking for an Audio-Visual Technician to join our team and contribute to this mission with technical skills and a proactive approach. GCA is looking for an Audio-Visual (AV) Technician to provide technical support for AV in a government enterprise environment. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting AV infrastructure and video teleconferencing (VTC) systems to ensure seamless collaboration for government and mission-critical operations.

Position Overview:
The Audio-Visual Technician supports the setup, operation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of AV equipment at client sites. This role involves direct interaction with clients to deliver quality AV solutions and provide support during conferences, meetings, and other events. Working under the guidance of senior AV technicians, this entry-level position is ideal for someone seeking hands-on experience in the AV industry.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Equipment Setup and Operation: Assist with the setup, testing, and operation of AV equipment, including monitors, video walls, video switchers, audio DSPs, projectors, microphones, and speakers to ensure functionality and quality during events.
  • Cabling Installation: Run various types of audio, video, and control cabling (e.g., HDMI, CAT6, XLR, speaker wires) to AV components such as speakers, microphones, monitors, video walls, and switchers, ensuring neat and secure installations.
  • Rack Building: Assist with AV rack building, including mounting and wiring equipment according to diagrams, labeling connections, and organizing cabling to maintain rack accessibility and functionality.
  • Troubleshooting and Maintenance: Conduct initial troubleshooting and maintenance of AV components; escalate issues as needed to senior technicians or engineers.
  • Customer Support: Provide on-site and remote support to clients for audio-visual setups, ensuring smooth operation during meetings and events.
  • Documentation: Maintain detailed logs of AV systems, setups, and troubleshooting steps; assist with preparing reports for equipment status and event support.
  • Technical Assistance: Assist senior technicians in configuring and installing AV equipment, including structured cabling and AV control system programming.
  • Inventory Management: Support inventory tracking, including equipment check-in/out, repair needs, and readiness for deployments.
  • Compliance and Safety: Follow all company safety protocols and federal compliance standards during equipment handling and installation processes.
Qualifications:
  • Certification: Avixa Certified Technology Specialist. Ability to obtain within 6 months.
  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Experience: 4-6 years with basic understanding of AV equipment (monitors, video walls, video switchers, audio DSPs, microphones, projectors, etc.), low-voltage wiring, and structured cabling; experience in rack building is a plus.
  • Soft Skills: Strong customer service and communication skills; ability to work well in a team and follow instructions accurately.
  • Physical Requirements: Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and work in varying environments (indoor and outdoor) as needed.
  • DoD Security Clearance: Must be eligible to receive a DOD Top Secret Security Clearance.

title: Lead Program Facilitator
description:
Lead Program Facilitator

POSITION SUMMARY

The Bay Area Discovery Museum is seeking a Lead Program Facilitator to join our Museum Experience team. This dynamic role facilitates and activates play-based learning programs, experiences, and environments, both onsite at the museum and in school and community settings. Lead Program Facilitators play a leadership role in guiding and catalyzing playful learning across museum programs including exhibits and festivals, school and community programs, and seasonal camps.

**We are particularly seeking bilingual candidates (fluent in English and Spanish, Cantonese, or Mandarin) in addition to candidates who are fluent in English and one of those additional specified languages.

Lead Program Facilitators bring a commitment to catalyzing and guiding playful learning that supports young children and their families to grow and thrive. They lead the activation of the museum floor and exhibits to create memorable and meaningful learning experiences for families with young children through planned and spontaneous playful interactions and games; open-ended questions and conversations that gently guide children’s play and model interactions for parent engagement; sharing information and suggestions with parents to enrich their families’ onsite experience and learning; and guiding Playful Learning Facilitators and Seasonal Playful Learning Assistants in their work to create a warm welcome and meaningful engagement for all visitors.

This position pays a rate of $27.24**/hour. This is a full-time union position, working 5 days per week onsite at our gorgeous 7.5-acre campus in Sausalito, CA. This position works Sunday-Thursday, with the possibility for one remote day a week. This role spends 95%+ of work time in a public-facing capacity on the museum floor.

**Bilingual candidates (fluent in English and Spanish, Mandarin, or Cantonese) will earn $28.24/hour.

KEY ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Museum Experience Floor, Support and Administration

  1. Leads the facilitation of daily museum drop-in onsite programs and such as Story Times, Pop Ups, Exhibit Activations, and Festivals.
  2. Participates in the development of, and delivers, special seasonal and year-round programs.
  3. Rotates through Museum Exhibits and engages in playful learning experiences with children and families.
  4. Facilitates programs in Spanish, Mandarin, or Cantonese, including translation of materials and communication (bilingual staff only).
  5. Works in partnership with other Playful Learning Facilitators and the Exhibits and Facilities team, to ensure that indoor and outdoor spaces are set up and maintained to be appealing, clean, and safe for all participants.
  6. Leads the daily opening and closing of museum exhibits in a complete and timely manner; Supports with daily closing announcements.
  7. Supports exhibits and programs with setup, clean-up and breakdown.
  8. Identifies and communicates material needs and exhibit/equipment repairs.
  9. Supports with trainings, leads and models programs and exhibit activations for Playful Learning Facilitators and Playful Learning Assistants.
  10. Participates in program ideation, prototyping, planning and evaluation, as required.
  11. Supports program administration and documentation with tasks such as organization of program supplies, creating program copy for Marketing, creating Program Signage as needed, creating Program Write Ups.
  12. Anticipates and problem solves day-of scheduling and other challenges, as appropriate.
  13. Supports as Floor Lead for the Museum Experience team one to two times per week.

Child and Adult Education

  1. Works in collaboration with the Child and Adult Education Department to lead the facilitation of Try It Truck Program in schools and community locations. This support takes place about twice a month.
  2. Trains to learn how to drive the Try It Truck, the museum’s mobile engineering lab.
  3. Motivates and guides playful learning; ensuring learning outcomes are met; activating teacher and parent engagement in the Try It Truck program, as appropriate.
  4. Facilitates programs in Spanish, Mandarin, or Cantonese, including translation of materials and communication (bilingual staff only)

Summer Camps

  1. Lead Program Facilitators support as one of several Camp Coordinators in the summer. This role supports summer camp leadership and staff, and coordinates program logistics. They are responsible for maintaining a positive and educational environment for campers and camp staff for designated seasonal camp sessions.
  2. Performs administrative duties, such as creating schedule rosters, maintaining inventory and restocking of supplies, preparing materials and other camp tasks.
  3. Supports with camp curriculum development.
  4. Assists with camp content training.
  5. Supports Senior and Junior Camp Facilitators on breaks and setting up activities. Serves as substitute Camp Facilitator as needed.
  6. Assists with addressing camper behavioral issues.
  7. Oversees and maintains museum supplies, equipment, and facilities. Manages camp lost and found.
  8. Participates in camp drop-off, pick-up, and written and verbal parent/caregiver communication.
  9. Works cooperatively to maintain open lines of communication with parents/caregivers, supervisors, and co-workers.
  10. Maintains a fun, positive, and friendly demeanor. Serves as an appropriate and positive role model for all campers, caregivers, and the general public.

Customer Service

  1. Ensures every visitor and program participant has an enjoyable experience, and feels welcome and taken care of, by providing exceptional customer service and communications centered in empathy, inclusion, and flexibility.
  2. Adheres to, communicates, and enforces museum policies and protocols around visitor safety and behavior.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years of experience working with children ages 0-8 years in formal or informal educational settings. Experience in education, arts education, early childhood education, museum studies, or relevant field preferred.
  • Understanding of early childhood development, pedagogy, and developmentally appropriate practice is preferred.
  • Ability to speak Spanish, Mandarin, or Cantonese is a plus.
  • Professional commitment to Diversity, Equity, Access, and Inclusion; thoughtful and open about the role of a workplace and a cultural institution in creating a sense of welcome and belonging for staff and visitors.
  • Excellent customer service skills.
  • Ability to take initiative, work independently, and troubleshoot in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Excellent oral, written, and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, dependability, flexibility, and an outgoing and friendly personality.
  • Ability to work with a variety of people from various backgrounds and cultures.
  • Comfort speaking in front of large and small groups.
  • Ability to perform physical activities such as bending, kneeling, walking, and picking up items for 2-3 hours at a time. Ability to stand for up to 8 hours and carry up to 50 lbs. for short distances/periods. Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varying types of weather.
  • Must possess current driver’s license, have a clear Motor Vehicle Record, personal car insurance, and reliable access to a car as local travel is required.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Ability to perform physical activities such as bending, kneeling, walking, and picking up items for 2-3 hours at a time.

  • Ability to stand for up to 8 hours and carry up to 50 lbs. for short distances/periods.
  • Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varying types of weather.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is primarily based in our indoor exhibit spaces and indoor office environment with standard office equipment and technology as well as. May work in remote locations, both indoors and outdoors, including travel in a vehicle to and from remote sites. May be exposed to varying types of weather when traveling to and from remote sites.

The Bay Area Discovery Museum is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity. We encourage those from all backgrounds to apply to allow us to build the most inclusive and creative team possible.

Please do not remove yourself from contention before you even apply. Research shows that women and individuals from underrepresented backgrounds often apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. If much of this job description describes you, then you are highly encouraged to apply.

WHAT WE OFFER

BENEFITS

  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision for employee only premiums
  • Life and long-term disability insurance
  • Paid time off starting at 3 weeks, on an accrual basis.
  • 10 days of sick leave (Five frontloaded, and the other five accrued throughout the year)
  • Nine (9) paid holidays and three (3) floating holidays.
  • Paid parental leave
  • Discounts at museum café and store, and on museum programs
  • All staff celebrations
  • Reciprocal admission benefits at other museums
  • Professional development training

ABOUT US


At the Bay Area Discovery Museum, we believe that providing children with the high-quality early learning experiences they need to be successful is the best investment we can make as a society.

Whether at the Museum, online, or in the community, we provide experiences that spark children’s natural curiosity for the world around them, while building their creative problem-solving skills and STEM content knowledge. Both on-site and off-site, we facilitate research-backed learning experiences that are fun and engaging for children and families. At our one-of-a-kind location at the foot of the Golden Gate Bridge, this includes hands-on exhibits, rich STEM and art programming, an on-site preschool, and camps and classes. Off-site, our museum educators bring hands-on STEM programming to students and families at schools and libraries in all nine Bay Area counties.

We believe that these research-backed on-site and off-site experiences should be made available to all children and families and offer a variety of access initiatives toward this goal. We are currently working our way back up to our pre-pandemic numbers:

  • 350,000 visitors each year, including nearly 100,000 with free or reduced admission
  • 10,000 member families
  • 26,000 children through our school and community programs
  • 587 schools and 215 libraries through all nine Bay Area counties

The Bay Area Discovery Museum is committed to being welcoming and inclusive. We are continuously working toward the goal of reflecting the diversity of the Bay Area both within our organization and with those we serve.

WHAT WE OFFER

The Bay Area Discovery Museum offers a high-energy, results-oriented, creative and fun environment. Employees enjoy reciprocal admission benefits at other museums, regular all-staff celebrations, professional development training, and more. All staff members are valued for their contributions toward creating a high-quality experience for visitors, and their work that allows us to achieve our mission.

The museum offers 100% employer-paid medical, dental, vision, life, and long-term disability insurance to all full-time employees, as well as generous paid time off starting at three weeks per year. Staff working an average of 20+ hours per week are eligible for many of the same benefit plans on a prorated basis.

In addition, we offer the opportunity for each employee to make a unique impact on more than 350,000 museum visitors each year on-site, and many more in the community through the museum’s research-backed school and community programs.

NOTE TO CANDIDATE
Due to the sensitivity and requirements of our positions, you should expect to undergo and be cleared of an employment background/criminal check if extended an offer for employment. You may also be asked to provide proof of educational degree(s), licenses, credentials, or vaccinations pertinent to the position.

title: Director, Media Analytics - LATAM
description:
About Us

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. AI at SharkNinja

Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

Position Overview
We're seeking a Director, Media Analytics – LATAM to lead full-funnel media measurement — spanning social, digital, retail, and traditional channels — across Mexico, Brazil, and the growing LATAM market. This is a player-coach role: you'll directly manage our Social Analytics Manager for the region today, while building the broader team and operating model this function will need as it grows.

This role carries the same capabilities we're building across the org — AI-powered, agent-driven insight generation and strong stakeholder management — applied here across the full media mix, not just social. You'll be hands-on with the hardest analyses yourself while also shaping the longer-term vision for the team.

  • Regional Leadership: Serve as the media analytics lead for LATAM, developing strategy while also executing hands-on analytics work across the full media mix.
  • Team Management & Development: Directly manage the region's Social Analytics Manager today, while shaping the team's future headcount, roles, and structure as it scales.
  • Full-Funnel Analytics: Lead measurement across all media types — digital, social, retail, and traditional — integrating data into a single, holistic view of performance.
  • AI-Driven Insight Generation: Direct the use of AI agents against media and marketing data to surface signal faster — orchestrating intelligent tools against good data, not manual reporting.
  • Signal Detection: Proactively identify signals, anomalies, or emerging patterns in media and market data to flag risks or opportunities before they escalate.
  • Macro Analysis: Assess how media investment contributes not just to channel-level optimization but to overall business efficiency and growth.
  • Stakeholder Management: Serve as the go-to analytics partner across a broad and growing set of stakeholders — regional marketing, brand, social, and finance leaders — managing competing priorities with clarity and poise.
  • Testing & Measurement Roadmaps: Drive the LATAM test-and-learn agenda, including MMM, attribution, incrementality, and rapid experimentation.
  • Insight Communication: Deliver compelling, concise narratives that influence executives and accelerate decision-making.

Attributes & Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field.
  • 8-10 years of experience in marketing/media analytics, with proven leadership responsibility.
  • Deep expertise in media measurement across digital and traditional channels, with strong knowledge of social platform analytics (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.) as well.
  • Experience applying advanced data visualization, statistical modeling, and forecasting techniques.
  • A genuine curiosity for AI-powered and agentic workflows, with a track record of using them to scale insight generation beyond what manual analysis could deliver.
  • Ability to both do the work and set the vision for building a regional team — this role starts as a player-coach and grows from there.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with proven ability to navigate a broad, cross-functional set of priorities across regional and global partners.
  • Excellent communication, influencing, and executive presence.
  • Fluency in Spanish and English required.

Work Environment
This is a primarily on-site role based in Mexico City, Mexico, with flexibility to work from home 1–2 days per week.

Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day. Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. We're looking for a Maintenance Technician to join our Operations team in Munich, taking ownership of the upkeep and reliability of our production workstation fleet and robotics infrastructure. This role suits someone with a technical software or computer science background, 3+ years of hands-on experience in a similar environment, and a track record of solving hardware and software problems independently in Linux systems.

You'll work directly with production machines, robotic hardware, and connected tooling — diagnosing root causes, resolving faults, and improving how our systems are maintained over time. This is a hands-on, onsite role for someone who takes initiative on unfamiliar problems, is comfortable moving between different types of technical work, and can be trusted to make sound calls with minimal oversight.

  • Maintain and improve GPU-enabled workstations, Docker environments, and related infrastructure.
  • Take ownership of unfamiliar or previously unseen technical problems, applying structured debugging and sound judgment to resolve them without needing to be walked through it.
  • Build and maintain documentation for issues, fixes, and procedures, and help shape how new equipment and tooling get tested and rolled out.
  • Spot recurring problems and propose fixes or process improvements rather than just resolving issues as they come up.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience maintaining Linux-based systems, hardware, or similar technical infrastructure.
  • Strong working knowledge of Linux and genuine fluency operating in the terminal / command line.
  • Solid programming and scripting skills (e.g. Python, Bash, or similar), with experience automating routine technical work.
  • Comfortable working hands-on with both hardware and software, including physical assembly and lifting of hardware/equipment.
  • Strong debugging skills and independent judgment, with a track record of working through new and unknown problems methodically and with minimal guidance.
  • Fluent in English.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with Docker, GPU-enabled systems, or robotics hardware.
  • Fluency in German.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Various employee subsidies and perks, including public transportation and wellness support
  • Work with a world-class team in a flat hierarchy, with direct collaboration alongside the founders and engineering team
  • Opportunity to make a real impact by working on cutting-edge robotics and AI systems

Recruiting Process

Your recruiting partner for this role is Madhulika (she/her). You can expect upto 4 rounds of interviews including an onsite visit to our office in Munich.

This role will drive the development, implementation and continuous improvement of cyber security strategy, governance frameworks, policies and controls to ensure Council's systems, networks, applications and data remain secure and resilient. Working closely with senior leaders, ICT teams and external partners, the Cyber Security Lead will provide expert advice, lead cyber security initiatives and influence strategic technology decisions across the organisation.

The successful candidate will play a critical role in strengthening cyber resilience, leading incident response activities, improving compliance outcomes and embedding a strong cyber security culture throughout the organisation.

  • Excellent understanding of cyber security legislation, regulatory requirements, standards and industry best practice.

title: Forward Deploy Engineer
description:
The Forward Deploy Engineer is the central point of contact and technical liaison for MDI customers in active implementation and supporting existing customers as they expand their integration offerings. You’ll lead the technical implementation process from kickoff to go-live, mapping and configuring API connections, reviewing logs, and troubleshooting issues to keep integrations on track.

This role is ideal for someone technically literate and highly comfortable working with APIs who enjoys problem-solving, learning new systems, and explaining complex concepts clearly to non-technical customers. This is not a software engineering role: you won’t be writing production code, but you will need to be confident configuring, testing, and debugging API connections independently. You’ll partner closely with the partner success and engineering teams, escalating clearly documented issues when they’re beyond the scope of this role.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Serve as the technical point of contact for new customers throughout implementation, and for existing customers expanding their integration footprint, guiding each engagement from kickoff through go-live.
  2. Lead the end-to-end technical implementation process, mapping and configuring API connections with customers and validating setup over screen share in real time. The average implementation timeline is days, not months.
  3. Monitor logs, dashboards, and tools like Postman to identify when APIs are misconfigured or behaving unexpectedly, and independently resolve the majority of issues without engineering involvement.
  4. Draft clear technical documentation for each issue encountered, including root cause, steps taken, and resolution, to build a reliable internal record and knowledge base.
  5. Escalate unresolved or complex issues to engineering with well-documented context, ensuring a smooth handoff and minimal back-and-forth.
  6. Translate customer inquiries and data needs into clear technical tasks and configuration notes, acting as the bridge between customer expectations and technical execution.
  7. Partner with the Partner Success Managers and Clinical Support teams to align technical capabilities with customer expectations throughout the relationship.
  8. Identify recurring issues or friction points across implementations and recommend ways to simplify, document, or automate the process.
  9. Maintain a high level of responsiveness, ownership, and customer empathy across both the finite implementation period and ongoing expansion work.

Success Looks Like…

  • Quick integration timelines driving a seamless go-live.
  • High customer satisfaction scores during integration and beyond.
  • Low number of escalations needing hands-on engineering resources.
  • Accuracy and completeness of documentation.
  • Responsiveness and collaboration across technical and customer teams.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years’ experience in a customer-facing technical support or implementation role with an emphasis on API-driven applications. Must be comfortable working with customers’ technical teams live, troubleshooting on video calls.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads, and HTTP status codes; comfortable reading logs and API documentation to identify root cause and resolve configuration issues without engineering support.
  • Familiarity with data mapping, payload structures, or basic scripting (Python, JavaScript, or SQL).
  • Experience using tools such as HubSpot, Postman or equivalent for troubleshooting and testing API calls.
  • Technically-savvy and able to communicate technical concepts and processes to both technical and non-technical users. This is a technical support/implementation role, not a software development role, so you won’t be writing production code, but you should be able to independently resolve the majority of configuration and integration issues you encounter.
  • Experience documenting integration processes or producing customer-facing support materials for internal and external use including workflows, process diagrams and SOPs.
  • High attention to detail and organization; able to manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and ability to learn new systems, data flows, and integration logic quickly.
  • Customer-first mindset: you thrive in helping customers solve problems and find clarity.
  • Experience in SaaS or healthcare technology integrations, a plus.


What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary: The targeted range for this mid-level position is $72,500 - $85,000 per year, DOE.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits package includes health, dental, and vision insurance with generous subsidy, company-covered life and disability insurance, and 401(k) with match for full-time, US-based employees.
  • Professional Development Opportunities: We are committed to investing in our employees' professional development and offer a variety of on the job training and growth opportunities.
  • Flexible Work Arrangements: We are a fully remote team who collaborate both synchronously and asynchronously to achieve the best outcomes.
  • Collaborative and Supportive Work Environment: We foster a collaborative and supportive work environment where employees are encouraged to share ideas and contribute to the company's success.

title: Data Operations Engineer
description:

We are looking for an ambitious, high-energy Data Operations Engineer to join our team in Singapore. We want someone with strong views on how things should work - and the technical ability and determination to make it happen. The ideal candidate looks at repetitive manual work and sees a problem to eliminate, not a process to tolerate. Intense focus on improving system availability and resilience through testing, standardisation and automation. Ability to build positive and collaborative relationships with colleagues across teams and geographies. Systematic and methodical approach to problem-solving and debugging.

title: Demand Planner
description:
Position Overview: We are seeking a highly organized and analytical Demand Planner to join our supply chain team. The Demand Planner will be responsible for forecasting product demand, managing inventory levels, and ensuring that the company can meet customer demand efficiently while optimizing stock levels. This role involves close collaboration with various internal teams, including sales, marketing, and supply chain, to ensure that demand plans align with business objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

Demand Forecasting:

  • Develop accurate demand forecasts using historical sales data, market trends, and input from sales and marketing teams.
  • Analyze and identify demand patterns, seasonality, and potential risks to the supply chain.
  • Regularly update and review demand forecasts, adjusting for changes in business conditions.

Inventory Management:

  • Monitor and manage inventory levels to ensure product availability while minimizing excess stock.
  • Collaborate with the procurement and warehouse teams to adjust supply plans based on demand forecasts.
  • Help set optimal stock levels across different product categories and distribution channels.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with the sales, marketing, and finance teams to ensure alignment on demand projections and sales targets.
  • Communicate forecast changes and any related issues to internal stakeholders.
  • Participate in sales and operations planning (S&OP) meetings to align demand and supply planning.

Data Analysis and Reporting:

  • Analyze sales data, inventory turnover, and other key performance indicators to identify opportunities for improving demand planning processes.
  • Provide regular reports on demand forecast accuracy, inventory performance, and customer service levels.
  • Use data analytics and forecasting tools to support decision-making.

Process Improvement:

  • Continuously improve demand planning processes to enhance forecast accuracy and efficiency.
  • Identify and implement best practices in demand forecasting, inventory management, and collaboration with other departments.

Supplier and Vendor Management:

  • Work closely with suppliers and vendors to ensure timely deliveries and resolve any potential supply issues.
  • Help coordinate product launches, promotions, and new product introductions with suppliers to meet demand.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Demand Planner, Supply Chain Planner, or similar role in demand planning or inventory management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret and manipulate large data sets.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to interact effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience with demand planning software and tools (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or similar ERP systems).
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Desired Skills:

  • Experience in a relevant industry (e.g., consumer goods, manufacturing, retail).
  • Knowledge of Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) processes.
  • Advanced forecasting techniques and statistical modeling knowledge.
  • Experience with inventory management and replenishment processes.

Additional Information:

  • Full-time position based in Quezon City.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

If you have the expertise and passion for optimizing demand forecasts and driving supply chain efficiency, we encourage you to apply and join our dynamic team!
