title: Senior Security Operations Analyst
description:
Life @ AP+

We are one connected team in pursuit of one inspiring purpose – to unite people and technology to power better experiences. Each of us has a part to play in making that happen. You’ll be encouraged to bring your big ideas forward and make a difference through your work. Taking steps forward in your career whilst still having room for fun, friendships, and flexibility in your daily life.

We’re driven by our core values: lead with heart, learn for tomorrow and live our legacy. A purpose like ours takes the inspired impact of an incredible team. Ready to change the game? We’re ready to help you do it.

The Purpose

As a Senior Security Operations Analyst, you’ll help protect the technology environments that support AP+ by identifying, investigating and responding to security events and incidents. You’ll play an important role in maintaining the day-to-day security of our environment, helping ensure potential threats are detected early, investigated thoroughly and managed through to resolution.

This is a hands-on role across security operations, incident and problem management, vulnerability assessment and threat intelligence. You’ll monitor security events and alerts, investigate suspected incidents and security breaches, and use security data to identify patterns, emerging threats and recurring issues. You’ll help turn this information into practical actions that strengthen our security controls and reduce the likelihood or impact of future incidents.

You’ll also contribute to the continuous improvement of security operations by analysing trends, supporting root-cause investigations, improving operational processes and helping implement preventative measures. Working with security and technology teams, you’ll help ensure security policies, controls, and operational procedures are working effectively and that security issues are investigated, escalated and resolved in line with agreed processes and service levels.

The role also provides an opportunity to contribute to threat intelligence and vulnerability assessment activities, helping AP+ better understand its threat landscape and identify vulnerabilities across its technology environment.

Key Responsibilities the Role Owns

  • Lead security monitoring across enterprise environments using SIEM, EDR and cloud security platforms, including review of alerts across security tools.
  • Investigate security alerts and indicators of compromise, correlate threat intelligence with internal telemetry and conduct proactive threat hunting.
  • Provide tuning recommendations for detection rules, use cases and alerting mechanisms to improve detection capability and reduce false positives.
  • Review MSSP threat-hunting reports and provide recommendations to improve the quality and relevance of findings.
  • Coordinate and lead the response to security incidents, including containment, eradication and recovery activities.
  • Perform detailed investigations to determine root cause, impact and remediation actions, and produce incident reports, lessons learned and post-incident reviews.
  • Identify opportunities to improve security operations processes, tooling and automation, and develop and maintain playbooks, runbooks and standard operating procedures.
  • Work with Security Engineering to develop test cases based on the AP+ threat profile and contribute to the maturity of MSSP capabilities.
  • Lead vulnerability assessment activities, assess security risk and coordinate remediation efforts across relevant teams.
  • Track remediation activities and work with remediation teams to address SLA breaches and reduce repeat SLA misses.
  • Provide risk-based recommendations on vulnerabilities, system changes and new technologies.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for complex security issues and provide specialist advice to stakeholders.
  • Prepare and present security metrics, operational reports and risk summaries.

You’ll likely be a strong fit for this role if

You’re a security operations professional who enjoys investigating what’s happening beneath the surface and turning security signals into practical action. You’ll bring experience across security operations, incident management, vulnerability assessment, threat intelligence, data analysis or operational technology support in a complex environment.

You’ll have a good understanding of security controls, incident and problem management, vulnerability assessment, threat intelligence, operational security tooling and controls. You’ll be comfortable analysing information from multiple sources, identifying patterns and trends, and communicating your findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Most importantly, you’ll bring a curious and methodical approach to security investigations, with the judgement to know when to escalate an issue and the mindset to look beyond resolving the immediate problem to identify what can be improved for next time. A relevant qualification, certification or equivalent practical experience in cyber security, information technology or security operations will be valuable.

What happens next

At AP+, we believe in the power of passion, pride and purpose. Our team is driven by a shared mission to make a difference in the world of payments, and we're proud to work together towards this common goal.

If you’re a security operations professional who enjoys investigating threats, solving complex security issues and helping make technology environments more secure, we’d love to hear from you.

If you’re ready to be a game changer, please submit your application. The Talent Acquisition team will endeavor to review your application and notify you of the outcome within the next two weeks.

We want to remove all barriers to inclusion, so if you need advice or support with your application, we’re here to help. Please reach out to recruitment@auspayplus.com.au. We also encourage you to let us know your pronouns at any point during the recruitment process.

AP+ are not partnering with Recruitment agencies for this role.

description:
The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to architect and scale the data backbone powering next-generation AI models in robotics and real-world environments.

This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, multimodal data processing, and applied machine learning, with a strong focus on building high-quality datasets for robotic foundation models. You will ensure that data pipelines, infrastructure, and data strategy directly translate into measurable improvements in model performance.

Your Responsibilities

  • Build and scale distributed data pipelines (Ray/Anyscale or similar) for TB-scale video, sensor, and robotics datasets
  • Design multimodal data schemas aligning video, actions, and high-frequency sensor streams
  • Develop Python tooling for data quality, including cleaning, anomaly detection, and dataset versioning
  • Own dataset quality and coverage, including annotation workflows, data diversity, and storage trade-offs
  • Lead a small team and coordinate with data providers and annotation vendors
  • Oversee real-world data collection, including technical setup, compliance, and secure data handling

Technologies

  • Python (advanced, production-grade)

  • AWS / GCP for large-scale data and GPU training pipelines
  • Video and sensor data formats (H.264/H.265, ROS bags, MCAP)
  • PyTorch, NumPy
  • DVC, LakeFS or similar data versioning tools
  • Distributed data processing and storage systems

Requirements

Must Have

  • 5+ years in Data/ML Engineering, including 2+ years in a senior or lead role
  • Experience with large-scale real-world data (robotics, autonomous systems, or video AI)
  • Strong experience with Ray/Anyscale or Spark for distributed pipelines
  • Advanced Python (performance, concurrency, ML stack like NumPy/PyTorch)
  • Experience working with video and sensor data formats (e.g., H.264/H.265, ROS bags, MCAP)
  • Experience building scalable data pipelines for GPU-based training workloads (AWS/GCP)
  • Experience with data versioning tools such as DVC or LakeFS
  • Proven experience owning systems and mentoring engineers

Nice to Have

Benefits

  • Work with a world-class team in a flat hierarchy, with direct collaboration alongside the founders and engineering team
  • Opportunity to make a real impact by working on cutting-edge robotics and AI systems

We hire across backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and we are committed to a workplace where everyone belongs. Discrimination has no place here.

title: Senior Manager of Information Security
description:
Who We Are


PS is redefining the way the world travels. We build and operate private airport terminals that transform commercial air travel into a seamless luxury experience. Currently serving guests at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL), and Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG), with new terminals just opened at Dallas Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) and Miami International Airport (MIA), PS is pioneering a new global standard in hospitality.


Far from the crowds and chaos of the public airport, PS offers members the privacy, ease, and security of the private flight experience while flying commercial. With exclusive partnerships with TSA and U.S. Customs and Border Protection, guests move effortlessly through line-free departures and arrivals. Every moment is carefully orchestrated by our expert team - private TSA screening, dedicated customs and immigration services, and luxury chauffeur transfers across the airfield directly to or from your aircraft.


Inside our private terminals, guests enjoy serene suites, chef-prepared dining, spa services, and personalized attention, while our Control Room coordinates discreetly with government, airline, and security partners to ensure unmatched efficiency, safety, and peace of mind. At PS, waiting in lines, crowded terminals, and luggage hassles give way to quiet elegance, service with heart and inspired experiences.


We are building more than terminals - we are shaping a new way to travel. If you’re passionate about luxury hospitality and excited to be part of something extraordinary, join us as we expand to new markets and reimagine the future of travel with PS.



Role: Senior Manager of Information Security

The Senior Manager of Information Security will serve as PS's dedicated information security leader, providing strategic direction, enterprise accountability, and hands-on oversight for the protection of the critical infrastructure and sensitive data that power PS's premium airport terminal operations.

Reporting directly to the Director of IT, this role will own the Information Security Management System (ISMS) and lead execution of the ISO 27001 roadmap, while strengthening security governance, security operations, audit readiness, third-party risk management, and organizational security maturity.

The role will partner with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to establish sustainable governance, improve executive visibility into organizational security posture, and build a scalable security program that supports business growth, new locations, and evolving regulatory, contractual, partner, and customer requirements. Success in this role will be measured by the establishment of a mature, evidence-driven ISMS and PS's successful progression toward ISO 27001 certification.

Reports to: Director of IT
Location: PS HQ (El Segundo, CA)
Schedule: Full-time, Hybrid

Responsibilities & Expectations

  • Own PS's Information Security Program, Information Security Management System (ISMS), and ISO 27001 certification roadmap, including readiness assessments, remediation planning, certification activities, surveillance audits, and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Establish and maintain information security policies, standards, procedures, and governance processes aligned with ISO 27001 requirements, contractual obligations, and business needs, partnering with Legal on regulatory and privacy considerations.
  • Lead, develop, and mentor the Cybersecurity Analyst team, establishing clear accountability for security operations, continuous monitoring, logging, incident response, and risk remediation.
  • Lead regular vulnerability assessments of all PS systems including penetration testing, bug bounty and passive scanning programs.
  • Lead operational development, testing, maintenance, and audit readiness activities for backup, incident response, disaster recovery, and business continuity programs in partnership with IT, Operations, and executive leadership.
  • Respond to and manage security incidents and investigations, including coordination of incident response.
  • Conduct regular internal security audits and assessments, including disaster recovery and incident response tabletops.
  • Lead audit readiness activities, including evidence management, remediation tracking, corrective action management, certification activities, customer assessments, and external audits.
  • Establish organization-wide evidence retention standards and processes to ensure security controls, audits, reviews, incidents, vendor assessments, training, and access management activities are consistently documented and audit-ready.
  • Promote a strong security culture across the organization through training, awareness, and policy development.
  • Establish and operate a formal access governance program, including user provisioning controls, privileged access oversight, periodic access reviews, and evidence retention.
  • Own the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program, including vendor classification, security due diligence, remediation tracking, ongoing oversight, and executive reporting of material third-party risks.
  • Partner with IT, Legal, HR, Finance, Operations, Airport Operations, and other business stakeholders to integrate security and vendor risk requirements into onboarding, contracting, implementations, ongoing vendor management, and business initiatives.
  • Maintain the Information Security Risk Register and provide executive reporting, governance forums, and leadership visibility into security posture, risk treatment, program maturity, and investment priorities.
  • Serve as PS's security leader in cross-functional and executive discussions, advising on business initiatives, technology investments, new locations, cloud services, payment systems, customer platforms, and regulatory or contractual requirements.
  • Build a scalable security operating model that reduces key-person dependency, clarifies ownership, and enables the security program to support company growth without increasing risk exposure.
  • Manage the security program roadmap, operating priorities, resource needs, and security investments in coordination with IT leadership and business stakeholders.


Requirements / Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years of progressively responsible information security experience, including leadership responsibility for security programs, audit readiness, governance, security operations, or certification initiatives. Previous experience building and maturing security programs is strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with ISO 27001 certification processes and audits, including working with certification bodies.
  • Strong understanding of information security governance, audit management, risk treatment methodologies, security operations, ISO 27001 controls, and security compliance frameworks.
  • Proven experience partnering across IT, Legal, HR, Finance, Operations, and other business functions to implement security and risk management requirements.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing teams, establishing accountability, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and driving complex information security programs at enterprise scale.
  • Exceptional client service and communication skills and a demonstrated ability to develop and maintain strong external and internal stakeholder relationships.
  • Demonstrated experience building repeatable, evidence-driven security programs capable of supporting external certification and audit requirements.
  • Proven experience leading internal and external audits, supporting enterprise risk programs, managing certification initiatives, and navigating regulatory and contractual requirements.
  • Strong executive communication and presence, with the ability to translate technical and security risks into clear business decisions for senior leaders, auditors, customers, regulators, and external partners.
  • Industry recognized certification like CISA, CIPP, CISSP, or CRISC, is advantageous.
  • Pass a pre-employment drug screening + background check in accordance with company policy.


Full-Time Employee Benefits

  • Employee benefits include medical, dental, vision, life insurance, long-term and short-term disability
  • 401K retirement plan with company matching
  • Health and Dependent care FSA and HSA with company matching
  • Merit-based raises and bonuses
  • Unlimited PTO

  • Paid training
  • Parental benefits 100% paid for up to 6 weeks
  • Friends & Family Discounted PS Use
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Level 4A PS Benefits
  • A great career path with promotion opportunities.


Salary range $170,000 - $190,000/annually. This is a full-time Exempt, Hybrid role.

title: Physiotherapist
description:
At Tall Tree, you’ll join an award-winning clinic focused on exceptional integrated healthcare. We’re a diverse team that is endlessly nerdy— we love learning, teaching, and keeping up to date with the latest research. We’re the most multidisciplinary and comprehensive team in private healthcare in BC; we put each client at the center of this with our goal to match everyone with the right clinician or team of clinicians. We take pride in our passionate clinicians, inspiring and uplifting facilities, high-quality health services, and exceptional customer service. We’re committed to delivering healthcare in the best possible way— and we have a singular culture of respect, warmth, curiosity and enthusiasm that makes being a part of the Tall Tree team something to be truly proud of.

Join a Team Obsessed with Best Practice, Growth, and Enjoying the Work We Do

Come be part of a team that’s unapologetically nerdy about best practice, lifelong learning, and having fun while doing it. As a Physiotherapist at Tall Tree, you’ll join a collaborative, interdisciplinary environment where mentorship, growth, and clinical excellence are at the heart of everything we do. One of our core values is constant improvement—and we live it out through weekly Lunch & Learns, “Papers & Pints” research nights, the annual Tall Tree Summit and built-in mentorship and peer learning!

This is an excellent opportunity for a new graduate who is eager to build a strong clinical foundation in a supportive, learning-focused setting. You’ll work alongside a multidisciplinary team, including occupational therapists, kinesiologists, psychologists, counsellors, and more—to deliver coordinated, high-quality care to a diverse range of clients.

You’ll be responsible for providing assessment and treatment services for clients with a variety of musculoskeletal concerns, persistent pain, and chronic health conditions.

Compensation:
Physiotherapists working full-time (5 days per week) can expect to earn around $90,000–$130,000+ annually.

The fee split for this role ranges from 54% to 64%, depending on experience and qualifications.

Hours:
We are open to someone looking for part time, full time, or for someone who is looking to build their availability to full time over time. We have shifts available Monday through Thursday from 2:00 - 8:00pm and Saturdays from 8:30 - 3:30pm. The expected start date for this position will be January 2027.

As a Physiotherapist, you will:

  • Conduct clinical assessments, treatments, and collaborative treatment planning for clients presenting with musculoskeletal conditions, persistent pain, neurological conditions, and/or mobility challenges related to aging or chronic disease.
  • Deliver exceptional care that is evidence-based, psychologically informed, and rooted in patient goals and values.
  • Collaborate with our team of kinesiologists, psychologists, clinical counsellors, and other health professionals to support integrated care when appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate clinical records in accordance with professional standards and to support multidisciplinary collaboration.
  • Keep growing. You’ll stay current with the latest evidence, findings, trends, and developments to ensure clients receive the best possible care, and attend other educational opportunities available at Tall Tree.

Requirements

We're looking for someone who is:

  • A Registered Physiotherapist in good standing with the College of Physical Therapists of British Columbia.
  • Clinically excellent, with a strong foundation in evidence-based practice, a commitment to ongoing development, and a deep respect for the individuality of each client’s experience.
  • Growth-oriented, with a passion for learning and a willingness to explore new methods and ideas in service delivery.
  • A skilled communicator, able to collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team and communicate clearly, empathetically, and confidently with clients.
  • Passionate about teaching and mentorship, eager to share knowledge and contribute to the learning culture at Tall Tree.
  • Curious and humble, showing up with openness, a collaborative spirit, and a commitment to delivering care that makes a difference.
  • Experience treating concussions is considered an asset. If you don’t have this experience, Tall Tree will support you with training and mentorship in specialized services such as concussion care.

Benefits

  • Beautiful facilities -Thoughtfully designed spaces inspire our best work. All of our facilities have been designed and crafted with care, reflecting our dedication to providing a welcoming and supportive environment for our patients, and a stellar work environment for our teams.
  • Keep growing - We dedicate a significant portion of our budget to continued education for our team. Whether it’s from our online learning platform full of courses, attending a conference, our journal club, lunch and learns, or through lunchroom chats with our colleagues, a deep love of learning is ingrained in our culture.
  • Guidance every step of the way - We’re committed to investing in your success every step of the way; our mentorship program pairs you with experienced team members who provide guidance and insights to help you continue to grow in your field. Our leadership development training equips you with the skills and confidence to take on greater responsibilities.
  • Prioritizing your health - We provide comprehensive health, dental, and life insurance plans designed to support you and your family’s well-being at every stage of life. Get free access to VO2 Max and DEXA testing, and Tall Tree’s gym and fitness facilities.
  • Hang out - Build deeper relationships at our annual Team Summit, and regular social events throughout the year. From inspiring guest speakers and professional development sessions to themed celebrations, group outings and board game nights, there are plenty of fun opportunities to fill your calendars!

Studies show that women and other marginalized groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. If this role feels like a great fit but you don’t check every single box, we encourage you to apply anyway! We’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse team and hire based on talent and potential.

Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. title: Senior Integration Advisor
description:
GENERAL JOB DESCRIPTION

The Senior Integration Advisor (SIA) is responsible for end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of acquired firm integrations, owning both integration leadership and critical operational execution to ensure seamless transitions. This role serves as MAI’s primary integration lead and is accountable for relationship management, cross-functional coordination, data readiness, and operational accuracy throughout the integration lifecycle.

The SIA functions as the single point of accountability for integration execution, owning integration strategy and coordination while confirming the accuracy of key data, valuation inputs, and system readiness activities required to successfully complete integrations.


MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Plan: Integration Strategy & Readiness

· Get involved before close to understand the acquired firm’s operations, data, systems, and risks

· Lead operational and client due diligence activities

· Build integration plans, timelines, and trackers tailored to each deal

· Flag data dependencies and system impacts early, and confirm valuation inputs are complete and accurate before execution


Execute: Integration Leadership & Operational Ownership

· Act as MAI’s main integration lead and day-to-day point of contact for the acquired firm’s leadership

· Run weekly integration calls, milestone check-ins, and issue resolution

· Coordinate and drive integration work across Finance, IT, HR, Operations, Marketing, and Shared Services


Own: Data, Valuation Support & System Readiness — owns the accuracy and execution of all integration-critical data and workflows, including:

· Valuation support: collect and confirm valuation inputs provided; verify accuracy and reconcile figures for consistency downstream

· CRM, billing, and custodial data: prepare, review, and submit CRM and billing import files; build, check, and troubleshoot Excel files and templates

· DocuSign and consent processes: handle CSV creation, form selection, and packaging of custodial and client paperwork

· Data quality assurance: keep data accurate, complete, and consistent across valuation, consent, CRM, and billing workflows


Partner: Cross-Functional Execution

· Work closely with Finance, IT, HR, Operations, Marketing, vendors, and custodians to complete integrations

· Keep ownership, timelines, and handoffs clear across teams

· Stay on top of dependencies and close gaps when ownership isn’t clear


Measure & Improve

· Track progress against timelines, financial targets, and operational milestones

· Spot recurring issues and help standardize, document, and improve the process

· Suggest changes to the integration approach based on lessons learned



EXPERIENCE/CREDENTIALS

· Bachelor’s degree required

· 5–7+ years of experience in financial services, RIA, or investment management, and in M&A, post-merger integration, or enterprise transformation

· Hands-on experience with valuation data support, CRM and billing system integrations, and Excel-based data modeling and reconciliation

· Track record of managing complex, cross-functional work under tight deadlines



COMPETENCIES

· Strong ownership mindset with tolerance for ambiguity

· Advanced Excel and data management skills

· Ability to interpret financial and valuation concepts

· Excellent interpersonal, facilitation, and communication skills

· High attention to detail and accountability for outcomes

· Ability to manage multiple integrations simultaneously

· Professional judgment, discretion, and integrity



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

· Integrations are complete on time with accurate data and minimal rework

· Acquired firms experience clear leadership and consistent communication

· Cross-functional partners understand expectations and dependencies

· Valuation, consent, CRM, and billing transitions occur without material issues

· Integration processes continually improve through documented lessons learned

Job Description

Job ID: MJ000352

We are looking for a Staff / Lead Data Engineer to own the architecture and evolution of our enterprise data warehouse. You will define how data is modelled, governed, and consumed across the organisation, creating a scalable foundation for analytics, reporting, and downstream data products.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who has personally designed and scaled complex data warehouse architectures, rather than only building pipelines within an existing framework.

Key Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end data warehouse architecture, including raw, staging, core/conformed, and data mart layers. Design scalable models for complex transactional domains such as bookings, payments, cancellations/refunds, amendments, supplier/customer flow data. Establish a single, governed metrics and definition layer to ensure consistency across business units and downstream consumers. Define and enforce data modelling, data contracts, quality, and engineering standards. Partner with Analytics, Data Science, Product, Finance, and business teams to translate requirements into scalable data solutions. Lead technical and design reviews and act as a trusted advisor for complex data architecture decisions. Mentor Data Engineers and raise the overall engineering and modelling standards of the team.

Requirements

Minimum 10+ years of Data Engineering experience, with experience operating at Staff, Lead, Principal, or equivalent level preferred. Proven experience designing large-scale data warehouses from the ground up. Strong knowledge of dimensional modelling, Data Vault, conformed models, and modern data architecture principles. Advanced SQL skills and hands-on experience with BigQuery, dbt, or equivalent technologies. Experience designing semantic/metrics layers and data contracts across multiple consumers. Strong understanding of large-scale transactional data and complex business logic. Strong technical leadership with experience reviewing architecture and mentoring other engineers. Experience in OTA, travel tech, e-commerce, marketplace, fintech is highly preferred.

title: Professional Education Coordinator
description:
Position Details

Title:

Professional Education Coordinator

Location:

Duke Farms, Hillsborough, N.J.

Reports to:

Deputy Executive Director of Science and Conservation

Status:

How to Apply:

Full time, non-exempt

Click here to apply and submit a résumé and cover letter. The priority application deadline for this position is October 1st. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled

BACKGROUND

Duke Farms is a living lab where model strategies for nature restoration, wildlife conservation and clean energy transition are developed. Located on 2,700 acres in Hillsborough, New Jersey, the campus serves as a gathering place for global decision-makers and local neighbors to ignite change.

As a center of the Doris Duke Foundation (DDF), Duke Farms advances the foundation’s mission to build a more creative, equitable and sustainable future. We work across three areas: arts & culture, nature, and health & well-being. In addition to Duke Farms, DDF operates five national programs as well as Shangri La, a global center for transformation located in Honolulu, Hawai‘i. DDF’s activities are guided by the will of Doris Duke, who endowed the foundation with financial assets that currently total over $2 billion. (To learn more about the foundation, visit .)

POSITION

The Professional Education Coordinator supports the Center for Conservation by designing, coordinating, implementing and evaluating professional education and training programs. This role partners across the Science & Conservation department to ensure smooth program operations, logistics, communications and participant support so that all educational programs run efficiently and reflect Duke Farms’ high standards.

By coordinating educational initiatives and a school partnership program, this position plays a key role in advancing Duke Farms’ mission to inspire people to become informed stewards of the land. Additionally, the role curates and publishes conservation and sustainability content for the Duke Farms website, helping make research and applied science accessible to broader audiences.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and Coordinate Professional Education and Training

  • Partner with Science & Conservation staff to design and deliver curriculum for professional programs, conferences, symposia and training initiatives.
  • Support the development and coordination of program content, timelines and materials to ensure accuracy and alignment with Duke Farms’ mission and standards.
  • Coordinate logistics, scheduling and communications for seminars, workshops, retreats and training programs developed by the Science & Conservation department.
  • Serve as primary contact for participants, ensuring clear communication and a welcoming experience before, during and after programs.
  • Manage registration, materials, vendor coordination and event-day execution.
  • Support ongoing evaluation, recordkeeping and reporting to measure the reach, quality and impact of all professional education initiatives.

Execute School Partnerships and Digital Engagement

  • Develop and implement curriculum for direct instruction of school programs, including lesson plans, presentations and resources, for the revamped school partnership programs, advancing conservation and sustainability education.
  • Manage logistics for other school visits, including registration, orientation and coordination with partner staff to ensure a smooth experience.
  • Build and sustain collaborative relationships with educators, students and other stakeholders, to ensure program access and provide key information and resources.
  • Curate and publish science and sustainability content on the Duke Farms website and social media, ensuring accuracy and accessibility.

Collaborate on the Execution of Convenings and Events

  • Provide programmatic and logistical support for convenings hosted at Duke Farms, incorporating educational elements in partnership with the Science & Conservation team.
  • Collaborate with Duke Farms’ Operations & Events staff to align on event logistics and services.

Perform other work, including special projects, as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in environmental science, education, ecology or related field.
  • Demonstrated experience in coordinating education, training or community programs, especially in conservation or sustainability contexts.
  • Familiarity with conservation science or sustainability.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with diversity of audiences and stakeholders.
  • Experience managing registration systems, scheduling or CRM platforms to streamline stakeholder communications and program delivery.
  • Proficient in using technology, including generative AI tools to drive efficiency.
  • Ability to navigate the 2,700-plus-acre Duke Farms property and travel to other locations, both indoors and outdoors, in various weather conditions.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 20 pounds.
  • Ability to work in various outdoor conditions including but not limited to heat, cold, sun exposure and wet weather with potential exposure to environmental factors such as poison ivy, ticks and mosquitoes.
  • Available to work flexible hours, including weekends, evenings and holidays.
  • A valid driver's license.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Anticipated starting hourly rate is $20.77 to $25.96, and the final offer will depend on experience.
  • Industry-leading benefits, including a 15% employer contribution to your 401(k), comprehensive health insurance, four weeks of paid vacation with additional paid time off, and matching gift benefits of up to $20,000 per year—all designed to support employees’ well-being, productivity and engagement.
  • A values-driven culture rooted in integrity, excellence, collaboration, openness and imagination, and diversity, equity and inclusion.

The Doris Duke Foundation is committed to inclusive hiring and equal employment opportunity. We strongly encourage candidates of all identities, experiences, orientations and communities to apply. Our recruiting and employment practices adhere to all applicable federal, state and local laws, including the Americans with Disabilities Act. We provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities. If a reasonable accommodation in the job application process is needed, please contact us here.

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

You will be expected to work with significant autonomy while maintaining close alignment with the Director-level AI leadership above you.

What Makes This Role Distinct:

title: Member of Technical Staff - Engineering
description:
About Patronus AI

Patronus AI is a frontier lab developing simulation research and infrastructure to accelerate progress toward human-aligned AGI. We are on a mission to simulate all of the world’s intelligence.

We are the team behind some of the earliest and most influential research in AI evaluation like FinanceBench, Lynx, SimpleSafetyTests, CopyrightCatcher, Humanity’s Last Exam, and more. We are formerly AI researchers and engineers from companies like Meta AI, Amazon AGI, and Google. Our customers include foundation model labs and Fortune 500 enterprises like Adobe. We are backed by top-tier investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Notable Capital, Stanford University, Noam Brown, Gokul Rajaram, and more.

Responsibilities

As a Member of Technical Staff – Engineering at Patronus AI, you’ll build the systems, infrastructure, and products that power our simulation research and agent training work.

This is a broad engineering role for people who like operating across boundaries. Depending on the problem, you might build a realistic RL environment end-to-end, design infrastructure for running thousands of agent trajectories, ship internal platforms used by researchers, deploy and serve models, or build AI-powered developer tools that make the entire team faster.

You’ll work across the stack — frontend interfaces, backend services, infrastructure, and ML/agent integrations — and partner closely with researchers and engineers to turn ambiguous problems into robust systems.

We’re looking for engineers with high ownership, strong product and technical judgment, and the ability to learn unfamiliar areas quickly. You don't need to be an expert in every part of the stack. You should have meaningful depth somewhere and the curiosity and engineering range to work wherever the problem requires.

In this role, you will:

  • Build agent environments and simulations end-to-end, including frontend interfaces, backend services, APIs, data models, tools, and realistic workflows used to train and evaluate AI agents.
  • Build the infrastructure that powers our agent gym, including orchestration, sandboxing, packaging, benchmarking, and systems for running environments across heterogeneous targets.
  • Develop internal platforms and developer tools used by researchers and engineers, from backends and dashboards to CLIs, SDKs, review agents, codegen helpers, and workflow automations.
  • Build and operate ML infrastructure, including model deployment and serving, evaluation systems, GPU workloads, and the services that make compute accessible to the broader team.
  • Own systems from ambiguous idea through production. Define the problem, make architectural decisions, implement the solution, instrument it, and iterate based on how it performs in practice.
  • Think deeply about correctness and failure modes. Design for edge cases, adversarial agent behavior, reproducibility, observability, and the messy realities of production systems.
  • Partner closely with researchers to productionize experiments and build the software and infrastructure needed to turn research ideas into scalable systems.
  • Be a power user of AI coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and similar tools — and build new tooling and automations on top of them when existing workflows aren't good enough.
  • Move quickly without sacrificing judgment. Make pragmatic decisions about what needs to be robust today, what can evolve later, and where technical investment will create leverage for the team.

Qualifications

“The number one qualification to succeed in this machine learning course is gumption” - John Lafferty, CS Professor at Yale

We're looking for a hands-on generalist who ships. Above all, we value strong product instincts, the ability to operate independently in ambiguity, and genuine curiosity about agents and the frontier of AI.

The list below is broad, and we don't expect every candidate to tick every box. What matters more is that you ship, stay curious, and use AI tools fluently enough to close gaps in days or weeks, not months. The team leans on AI tooling heavily to ramp on unfamiliar areas, and we expect anyone joining to do the same.

You are a strong fit if you have:

  • A track record of shipping non-trivial software end-to-end as an individual contributor, ideally at a startup or on a small, high-velocity team.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals and meaningful depth in at least one of backend/infrastructure, frontend/product engineering, or ML systems, with the ability and desire to work across boundaries.
  • Experience building production systems in languages such as Python, Go, and/or TypeScript, and the ability to become productive quickly in an unfamiliar stack.
  • Experience working with modern LLMs and agents at the application level — including concepts like tool calling, agent loops, context management, harnesses, and evaluation.
  • Strong engineering judgment around system design, correctness, reliability, failure modes, edge cases, and operational complexity.
  • High independence. You can take an ambiguous goal, determine what needs to be built, find the people or information necessary to unblock yourself, and ship without requiring the work to be fully pre-scoped.
  • Fluency with modern AI coding tools and a strong instinct for where AI can automate or accelerate engineering workflows.
  • A BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field — or equivalent experience.

Depending on your area of depth, you may also have experience with:

  • Building complex full-stack products using technologies like React, TypeScript, Next.js, Python, relational databases, and modern API frameworks.
  • Building developer platforms, distributed systems, orchestration systems, sandboxes, or internal infrastructure.
  • Reinforcement learning environments, agent evaluation, verifiers, reward models, or benchmarking infrastructure.
  • Deploying and serving ML models using managed inference providers or self-operated GPUs.
  • GPU infrastructure, workload schedulers, Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure.
  • MLOps/LLMOps tooling, experiment tracking, model registries, and production observability.
  • Browser automation tools such as Playwright or Selenium.
  • Building or deeply using complex enterprise software and understanding the operational edge cases that accumulate in real-world systems.

We don't expect you to check every box. We're more interested in engineers who have demonstrated exceptional depth somewhere, can learn quickly, and are excited to take ownership of whatever technical problem matters most.

To support close collaboration, this role is based in our San Francisco headquarters and requires in-office attendance 5 days a week.
The expected base salary range for this role is $175,000 - $300,000 USD. In addition to base salary, we offer equity and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, skills, and location.

Patronus AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Backend Engineer, AI Systems
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

Role As a Backend Engineer, AI, you own the inference and orchestration layer that powers every AI interaction in the product. Your work sits between models and users, where latency, correctness, reliability, and cost directly impact real-world experience. Build and operate production systems that turn model capability into fast, stable, observable APIs used across mobile and desktop clients.

Focus Build and operate backend systems that serve AI-powered features in production. Design inference pipelines and orchestration layers that handle multi-step workflows, tool calls, and retries Manage the full lifecycle of AI requests: routing, caching, batching, streaming, and state management Optimize latency, throughput, and cost across model inference and downstream systems Design systems that remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior and external dependencies Implement observability for AI systems, including logging, tracing, and debugging of model outputs and failures Collaborate with ML and product teams to translate model capabilities into stable, production-grade APIs

Ideal Experiences Strong backend engineering fundamentals in production environments. Experience running high-throughput, low-latency services. Familiarity with AI inference patterns (LLMs, embeddings, multimodal). Comfortable debugging distributed systems under load. Bias toward shipping and learning from production behavior.

Outcomes Backend systems run reliably at scale, handling production AI traffic with low latency and high throughput. Multi-step AI workflows complete successfully across tools and services, with robust handling of failures and retries APIs are stable, clear, and support seamless integration with frontend and ML systems. Production incidents are quickly detected, diagnosed, and resolved, minimizing user impact. Iterative improvements based on real usage continuously increase system performance and reliability. System design evolves to support increasing scale, complexity, and new AI capabilities without major rewrites.

Tech Stack Python NodeJs Pytorch OpenAI / Anthropic / open-source LLMs SQl & noSQL Kubernetes Docker

How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams.

We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

Interview process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

About the Role

Uber Freight is looking for a Logistics Specialist to join our Cross Dock Center of Excellence. This isn't just about moving freight; it’s about mastering the complexity of modern cross-dock logistics. You will be the architect of efficient transportation and facility flow strategies, leveraging cutting-edge technology to ensure high-stakes shipments maintain strict FIFO compliance, reach their destinations on time, and help mitigate impacts to the customer's budget.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment where your decisions directly impact the bottom line, facility throughput, and the customer experience, this is the place to build your career.

Why Join Us?

  • Technological Edge: Work with and integrate industry-leading Transportation Management Systems (TMS), Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), and data tools.
  • Impact: You aren't just following a process; you’re analyzing freight flows, preventing bottlenecks, and recommending improvements that shape our cross-dock transportation strategy while minimizing downstream impacts.

What the Candidate Will Do

  • Master the Cycle: Navigate the full lifecycle of an order—from inbound load building to outbound tendering—using our advanced TMS and collaborating seamlessly with WMS platforms to maximize peak facility potential.
  • FIFO & Freight Flow Ownership: Take complete ownership of freight planning through the cross-dock facility, ensuring all inbound and outbound shipments are strictly planned and executed based on FIFO (First-In, First-Out) principles to maintain optimal throughput and avoid dwell times.
  • Strategic Sourcing & Scheduling: Build powerhouse relationships with customer-selected carriers. Leverage pre-planned static routes and select the lowest-cost, most efficient providers from participating carriers, ensuring dock schedules align for continuous delivery.
  • Data-Driven Problem Solving: Proactively identify performance trends, resolve shipment errors, and prevent dock bottlenecks. Ensure customer freight visibility by managing ASN/EDI data flows, as well as CSV shipment file uploads for non-EDI information.
  • Act as an Advisor: Train new users on our systems (TMS/WMS interactions) and document standard operating procedures that set the gold standard for cross-dock operational excellence.
  • Collaborative Resolution: Serve as the critical link between shippers, receivers, facility operators, and carriers to resolve complex transloading and logistical challenges with professional poise.

  • Foundational working knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and inventory flow principles, including FIFO.
  • Intermediate proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office Suite.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Transportation, Logistics, or Supply Chain Management.
  • 3+ years of deep experience in the logistics industry, with specific experience in a cross-dock or fast-paced transload facility.
  • Proven ability to collaborate between TMS and WMS systems to drive operational alignment.
  • Analytical Mindset: Familiarity with BI and Tableau reporting to turn data into actionable insights for facility and freight performance.
  • Advanced proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office Suite.

title: Mission Analyst
description:
ABOUT THE JOB
We are looking for a Mission Analyst to serve as Anduril’s tactical-level interface with the military operators and planners who will employ our autonomous maritime systems. This is the person the customer works with day-to-day — embedded in their environment, speaking their language, and ensuring our capability is employed effectively.
This is not a desk job. You’ll be working alongside the customer, deployed on exercises, delivering training, supporting mission planning, and feeding operational reality back into engineering. You’ll help shape how the capability is used, how operators are trained, and how lessons from the field make it back to the people building the system.
This position is available in Sydney, Australia. While based in Sydney, this role requires regular travel to customer sites, exercises, and operations.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
• Support development of mission plans for exercises, demonstrations, operational test and evaluation, and operational employment
• Provide tactical advice to customer planners on system capabilities, limitations, and employment options
• Develop and maintain tactical procedures, checklists, planning aids, and quick-reference materials
• Contribute to the development and refinement of Concepts of Employment (CONEMP) and Tactics, Techniques and Procedures (TTPs)
• Support the training organisation in the delivery of operator training, including preparation of training materials and subject matter support during course delivery
• Provide operational mentoring and tactical coaching to operators during exercises and employment activities
• Plan and execute Anduril’s operational contribution to exercises and demonstrations
• Capture user feedback on system performance, usability, and employment concepts and translate it into actionable input for engineering and product teams
• Identify gaps in procedures, training, or system capability from the operator’s perspective and advocate for the user within Anduril
• Ensure operating procedures and training content reflect current employment concepts and real-world operational patterns
• Build and maintain trusted peer-level relationships with customer operators and planners through persistent presence and demonstrated competence
• Support post-exercise debriefs and lessons learned capture, feeding outcomes back into CONEMP, TTPs, and training content
• Contribute operational input to program reporting and customer performance reviews


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience in operational planning, mission analysis, capability development, or a related field such as
defence, aviation, mining, or complex logistics
• Demonstrated ability to work at the tactical level — translating system capabilities into practical
employment options
• Experience delivering training, instruction, or coaching in a Defence or technical context
• Strong interpersonal skills — able to build trust with military operators and planners as a credible peer
• Comfortable working autonomously in a customer environment with minimal direction
• Ability to translate complex system capabilities into clear operational language that users can act on
• Strong written communication — able to produce tactical procedures, planning aids, and operational
reports
• Eligible to obtain and maintain a Negative Vetting Level 2 (NV2) security clearance


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Military background with operational experience in a maritime environment (submarine, surface warfare,
mine countermeasures, or equivalent)
• Experience with autonomous systems, unmanned platforms, or emerging military technology
• Experience in a Defence industry customer-facing role
• Knowledge of undersea warfare and maritime warfare concepts
• Understanding of Defence acquisition processes
• Experience contributing to Concept of Operations (CONOPS), CONEMP, or TTP development
• Experience with operational test and evaluation, exercise planning, or wargaming

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

description:

Our team of highly skilled technicians perform a dynamic range of services to include but not limited to valve repair, in-line testing, upgrades/modifications, and turnkey outage solutions to premier leaders in the process industries.

VALVE TECHNICIAN / MECHANICAL FIELD TECHNICIAN

Atlantic Valve Services (AVS) | Swedesboro, NJ & Northeast/Mid-Atlantic Region | Full-Time

Build a Career in a Specialized, Respected Industrial Trade

Are you a skilled trades professional looking for your next opportunity? Do you have hands-on experience as a mechanic, machinist, hydraulic technician, plant technician, or maintenance professional? Atlantic Valve Services (AVS) is looking for motivated, technically-minded individuals to join our growing team and develop into highly skilled Valve Technicians.

Whether your background is in the military, heavy equipment repair, manufacturing, food production, refinery operations, hydraulics, automotive, shipyards, power generation, or industrial maintenance, we provide the training and support needed to build a long-term career in a specialized and respected trade.

About Atlantic Valve Services

Atlantic Valve Services (AVS) is a full-service safety relief and control valve repair center supporting customers throughout the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic region. We are a premier service provider for Emerson/Fisher control valves and an authorized assembler of Anderson Greenwood, Crosby, and Kunkle pressure relief valves. AVS provides repair, testing, calibration, diagnostics, upgrades, and field services for critical industrial facilities.

Our technicians work on equipment that helps keep manufacturing plants, energy facilities, pharmaceutical companies, refineries, food production facilities, and industrial operations running safely and efficiently.

Why Join AVS?

  • Paid hands-on training in a specialized, high-demand trade
  • Factory training opportunities with industry leaders (Emerson, etc.)
  • Learn highly specialized skills valued across industries
  • Work alongside experienced technicians and mentors
  • Competitive pay with overtime opportunities
  • Premium medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Stable, long-term career with clear advancement opportunities
  • Clean, professional work environment
  • Exposure to a wide range of industrial equipment and customer sites
  • Opportunity to work on equipment critical to major industrial operations

What You'll Do

As a Valve Technician, you'll learn to inspect, maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and test industrial valves and related equipment used in critical process industries. Working alongside experienced technicians, you will:

  • Perform maintenance, inspection, and repair activities on industrial valves and related equipment
  • Assist with the assembly and disassembly of control valves, safety relief valves, and isolation valves
  • Learn diagnostic and troubleshooting techniques to identify equipment issues
  • Conduct valve testing, calibration, and performance verification
  • Read and follow technical procedures, drawings, and service documentation
  • Complete service reports and maintenance records
  • Support customer outages, maintenance projects, and field service activities
  • Maintain high safety standards at customer facilities and AVS locations
  • Collaborate with experienced technicians and engineers to continuously develop your skills

We're Looking for Skilled Trades Professionals

We actively recruit from diverse technical backgrounds. We encourage applications from:

Military Veterans:

  • Marine Corps, Navy, Army, Air Force, and Coast Guard veterans
  • Machinist's Mate (MM), Tank mechanics, Aviation and Avionic mechanics
  • Vehicle and diesel technicians, Power generation technicians
  • Shipyard personnel

Industrial & Manufacturing Professionals:

  • Machinists and precision mechanics
  • Hydraulic and pneumatic technicians
  • Equipment technicians and maintenance professionals
  • Millwrights and heavy equipment mechanics
  • Manufacturing maintenance and production technicians
  • Field mechanics and service technicians

Plant & Facility Operators:

  • Food production plant technicians and operators
  • Refinery technicians and mechanics
  • Power plant and utility technicians
  • Petrochemical and chemical plant technicians
  • Pharmaceutical manufacturing technicians
  • Water treatment and utility operators

Other Mechanical Backgrounds:

  • Automotive repair and mechanics
  • HVAC technicians transitioning to industrial work
  • Diesel mechanics
  • Equipment repair specialists
  • Welders with mechanical aptitude
  • Any mechanically inclined individual with strong work ethic and willingness to learn

Previous valve experience is a plus, but it is NOT required. We're looking for people with strong mechanical aptitude, hands-on experience in skilled trades, and genuine interest in building a specialized career.

Qualifications

Required:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving ability
  • Hands-on experience in a skilled trade (military service, manufacturing, maintenance, repair, plant operations, etc.)
  • Ability to use hand tools and basic mechanical equipment
  • Willingness to learn and master a specialized industrial trade
  • Strong work ethic and reliability
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Commitment to workplace safety
  • Valid driver's license
  • Ability to travel throughout the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic region as needed

Preferred:

  • Shipyard, refinery, or plant experience
  • Military mechanical experience
  • Industrial maintenance or manufacturing experience
  • Mechanical repair or troubleshooting background
  • Experience with hydraulic, pneumatic, rotating, or process equipment
  • Experience reading technical drawings, schematics, or maintenance procedures
  • Prior valve, instrumentation, or controls experience
  • Food production or manufacturing plant background

Travel & Work Environment

This position includes work in both shop and field environments. Travel throughout the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic region may be required depending on customer needs and project schedules. Candidates should be comfortable working in industrial facilities, performing physically active work, and occasionally working overtime.

Ready to build a specialized career?

Apply Now!

Atlantic Valve Services (AVS) offers a standout culture, fantastic work environment, and has very competitive benefits to include premium medical, 401K match, and other unique incentives.

title: Seasonal Education Coordinator (Georgia)
description:
Organizational Mission:

The Appalachian Trail Conservancy’s mission is to protect, manage, and advocate for the Appalachian National Scenic Trail.

Position Summary

The Education Coordinator will report to the Regional Manager and will support registered thru-hikers and provide education on Leave No Trace, local rules & regulations, proper food storage, and other pertinent information. The Education Coordinator works primarily at the designated basecamp and will work with ATC staff and trail club volunteers. This role will help ensure consistent educational messaging, capacity for important food storage demonstrations, and better balance of shared duties with volunteers.

Volunteers will continue to help assist at the designated basecamp location and provide primary coverage during the coordinators off days. This role will have positive educational conversations and help prevent a cascade of negative effects on natural resources and the trail that would otherwise reach not only the specific region, but the rest of the Appalachian Trail.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Start Smart video presentations for registered thru-hikers and answer visitor questions with a Leave No Trace focus in messaging.
  • Participate in weekly check-in calls with all stakeholders including ATC partners, volunteers, and internal staff.
  • Update messaging focus boards based on information from partners.
  • Demonstrate PCT-style hangs when requested.
  • Ensure ATC’s Incident Report and Bear Encounter Report Forms are shared with visitors.
  • Coordinate with designated Trail Ambassador Coordinator on coverage at basecamp. • Troubleshoot technology issues as they arise from digital tablet registration
  • Ensure good communication with park service on needs for the AT.
  • Other duties as assigned by the Regional Manager.

Qualifications

  • Academic experience or course work in environmental studies, recreation management, natural resources management, forestry, or related field preferred.
  • Commitment to ATC management and resource protection efforts.
  • Proven ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with individuals, groups, and partners.
  • Ability to live independently and work in a remote area with minimal supervision.
  • Strong hiking and outdoor experience.
  • Experience in collaborating with volunteers of all ages, backgrounds, and skill levels.
  • Basic knowledge of Appalachian Trail Conservancy’s cooperative management system preferred.
  • Leave No Trace Trainer or Master Educator desirable, awareness training is provided.
  • Current Wilderness First-Aid, or higher, and CPR certification is preferred training is provided.
  • Willingness to participate in additional required training which includes but not limited to: USFS chainsaw & crosscut saw certification, WFR/WFA, advanced rockwork, rigging, safe driving.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

  • Must be able to hike for extended periods and perform routine moderate lifting carrying up to 50 pounds in a backpack over a minimum of five miles through rough, uneven terrain, and wet, and slippery surfaces.
  • Possible exposure to ticks and pests, extreme weather, and hazards typical of a backcountry environment.
  • Regular use of a computer is required; Microsoft Office, Office 365, ESRI GIS, NPS database, APD, NetSuite, RIMS, and Google applications are used.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license, and access to a reliable personal vehicle.

Additional Details:

  • 12-week season beginning in early February and finishing at the end of April.
  • In-person training will begin Monday February 1st, 2027. Any remote training components that take place prior to the in-person training will be communicated ahead of time.
  • The last day of the season will be Monday April 19th, 2027.
  • Up to $500/month housing stipend available if needed.
  • Hourly Rate: $19.00 - $21.00
  • Benefits: 1 hour of sick time per 30 hours worked.

title: Baker - Seaport
description:
Competitive triathletes and passionate bakers, Pam Weekes and Connie McDonald left their careers to open a small bread shop in New York City in 1995 — Levain Bakery.


One day, they baked a BIG chocolate chip walnut cookie as energy for triathlon training. At Levain, a batch of these 6-ounce cookies flew off the shelves, and an icon was born. The cozy shop on West 74th Street became a neighborhood favorite and a destination for epicurious visitors from around the world, hungry for “the cookie.”

From the start, Pam, Connie, and the team baked everything fresh on-site each day, donating the day’s leftovers to charity — and we still do, nearly 30 years later. Today, Levain has bakeries across the country (with more to come!), plus ecommerce gift boxes to treat cookie lovers in every state.

Our Vision: To give rise to lifelong memories

Our Mission: To bring together people who treat their work and the craft of baking and all who come to visit with great care.

Every day, we strive to embody our company’s five core values:

  • Welcome All- We are all in it together
  • Work Hard and Be Kind- We pull our weight, we do our best, and take care of each other
  • Lead with Heart- We operate with empathy and integrity
  • Rise Up- We take initiative to make things better
  • Savor It- We are present and find the fun!

THE ROLE: BAKER

Bakers bring their unique skillset to the bakeries and maintain the high quality and consistency of our products, ensuring that every item meets our standards of excellence. The ideal Baker candidate has in-depth baking knowledge, strong problem-solving instincts, and a passion for baking accurate recipes and following protocol.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong communication & interpersonal skills; team-oriented with a positive, empathy-forward attitude
  • Maintain a high level of professionalism and care; be adaptable, flexible, and patient
  • Must be reliable, responsible, and punctual
  • Be open to feedback and committed to continuous improvement
  • Ability to continuously motivate and inspire team members and set a positive example for the team
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure in a fast-paced environment when troubleshooting issues: be consistent, patient, and even keeled
  • Detail-oriented: the highest standards for accurately following recipes
  • Embody and promote the values and standards of Levain Bakery

Job Responsibilities:

Team Collaboration:

  • Lead with curiosity and compassion by showing care for your co-workers and build meaningful connections that broaden your perspective
  • Display a strong sense of teamwork: Work collaboratively with team members to ensure smooth store operations
  • Facilitate open, clear, and timely communication with your team members and management
  • Stay informed about new products, procedures, and promotions

Baking & Quality Control

  • Bake bread, cakes, muffins, cookies, and other baked goods according to Levain Bakery’s recipes and standards
  • Measure, mix, weigh, shape, and prepare various products, ensuring proper consistency and following specific techniques and guidelines
  • Monitor baking times and temperatures to maintain product quality and consistency
  • Manage daily pars to ensure all baked goods meet quality standards and customer demands
  • Follow and comply with established procedures, including weights and measures, health and sanitation, and safe work practices
  • Spot check finished products: taste, smell, feel, and assess overall visual consistency

Operations

  • Consistently adhere to established protocols and maintain the highest standards of excellence to ensure all baked goods meet Levain Bakery’s quality standards
  • Arrive to station on time, in uniform, and ready to work
  • Ensure baking ingredients are appropriately stocked using FIFO (first in, first out) processes
  • Occasionally interact with customers, answering questions about our baked goods

Requirements

  • Minimum 1-2 years of baking experience
  • Open availability: ability to work mornings, nights, weekends, and holidays
  • Ability to lift/push 50 pounds

  • Read and communicate in English, both verbally and in writing

description:
Senior Software Engineer | 100% remote (Brazil) | PJ (Long-Term)

We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to design, build, and ship production-ready backend services, internal tooling, and web applications. This is an opportunity for a highly autonomous engineer who is comfortable working through ambiguity, influencing technical direction, and owning projects end-to-end.

The strongest technical background for this role combines Java, Kotlin, Ruby, and React. While the existing technology ecosystem includes Ruby and Elixir, new development is increasingly focused on Kotlin and Java, making strong JVM fundamentals particularly important for this position.

You will work closely with product, design, engineering leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex problems, make sound architectural decisions, and build reliable systems that are easy to operate and extend.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, test, and deploy backend services, APIs, internal tools, and user-facing web applications.
  • Own medium-to-large features and projects end-to-end, from requirements and system design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Develop primarily across a modern stack including Kotlin, Java, Ruby, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB.
  • Contribute to new projects built with Kotlin and Java, applying strong JVM engineering fundamentals.
  • Work with existing Ruby and Elixir-based systems, contributing to and extending established services where needed.

  • Integrate services with neighboring teams, shared platforms, and complex domain systems.
  • Review pull requests, provide thoughtful technical feedback, pair with teammates, and support onboarding and knowledge sharing.
  • Deploy user-facing and operator-facing functionality responsibly to production.
  • Improve system reliability and maintainability through observability, metrics, monitoring, incident analysis, and continuous technical improvement.
  • Leave systems easier to understand, operate, and extend than you found them.

What We're Looking For

Core Technical Skills

The strongest candidates will have a combination of:

  • Java
  • Kotlin
  • Ruby
  • React

Required Experience

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong experience building production-ready backend systems and web applications.
  • Hands-on experience with Java and/or Kotlin, with the ability and willingness to work extensively on JVM-based services.
  • Professional experience with Ruby and React or comparable full-stack technologies.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, software design, APIs, databases, and distributed systems.
  • Experience influencing technical direction rather than simply implementing predefined requirements.
  • Experience with system design and architectural decision-making.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, version control, IDEs, and deployment tooling.
  • Understanding of event-driven architectures and event streaming, such as Kafka.
  • Strong database fundamentals and experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with GraphQL or comparable API technologies.
  • Ability to work with complex domain data, business rules, validations, and integrations across multiple services.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and other stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously and effectively in ambiguous environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Production experience developing Kotlin and Java services, including common JVM frameworks and tooling.
  • Experience working with Ruby and/or Elixir in production environments.
  • Experience designing and building microservices integrated with neighboring teams or shared platforms.
  • Experience with eCommerce, marketplace, or other complex transactional platforms.
  • Experience with AWS and serverless technologies such as Lambda.
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming platforms.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, or similar relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Experience integrating LLMs or managed AI APIs into backend services or internal tooling, including use cases such as enrichment, classification, attribution, or human-in-the-loop workflows.
  • Experience with production monitoring, dashboards, observability, and incident response.
  • Experience using Python for production backend or service-oriented development.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a senior-level full-stack engineer with strong Java/Kotlin fundamentals, solid Ruby and React experience, and a proven ability to take ownership of complex projects from concept to production.

We are especially interested in engineers who are generalists at heart—people who can move between backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems, and infrastructure when the problem requires it, rather than being limited to a single technology or specialty.
