title: AI Agentic Workflow Reviewer
description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

We're building a dedicated reviewer team to evaluate complex, real-world agentic AI workflows, assessing whether AI agents complete tasks safely, respect user intent and consent, and hold up under close scrutiny. This isn't routine content moderation: reviewers work through ambiguous, multi-step scenarios where judgment calls matter as much as checklists. You'll operate inside isolated test environments, apply structured rubrics, and help calibrate what "safe and policy adherent agent behavior" actually looks like.

What You’ll Own:

  • Review multi-step agent task trajectories against rubric-based criteria covering task success, safety, and policy adherence
  • Evaluate whether an agent respected user agency and informed consent — not just whether it followed literal instructions
  • Apply privacy guardrails when reviewing tasks involving sensitive or personal data
  • Work inside isolated test environments, including verifying environment resets between test runs to prevent cross-contamination
  • Flag and escalate safety-relevant or ambiguous findings through defined escalation paths

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
  • 2–5+ years in quality review, QA/QC, trust & safety, content moderation, data annotation, or a similarly judgment-intensive review role
  • Strong written communication – you can justify a scoring decision clearly enough for someone else to audit it
  • Comfort with ambiguity and structured decision-making under a rubric, rather than needing a fixed rulebook for every case
  • Baseline understanding of AI/ML concepts and how AI agents complete tasks (can be learned through onboarding, but some familiarity helps)

The expected hourly salary range for this position is $50-$55p/hour, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

description:

This role offers real technical ownership, exposure to high-impact projects and the opportunity to shape reliable, future-proof power systems together with leading experts.

What will you do as HV/ MV Lead Electrical Engineer (MCF/ Data Centres)

You act as the client side HV/ MV electrical engineer on mission critical and data centre projects, with a strong focus on substation design, grid connections and technical governance. You support clients from early feasibility through design development and delivery, ensuring that electrical infrastructure solutions are robust, compliant and future-ready.

Key activities include:

  • Defining HV and MV system concepts and substation design strategies from an owner engineer perspective;
  • Developing and reviewing HV substation layouts, including primary equipment selection, system architectures, protection strategies and earthing philosophies;
  • Proposing system optimisations to clients to improve reliability, increase future flexibility, reduce cost or shorten time-to-market in line with their decision drivers;
  • Leading and interpreting electrical studies to support grid connection and design decisions;
  • Managing technical interfaces with utilities, clients and delivery partners and reviewing contractor designs and technical submissions to safeguard quality, compliance and performance.

Where you will work

At Haskoning, you will join an independent, employee-owned international consultancy that combines engineering, design, and consultancy services with software and technology. Our mission, "Enhancing Society Together," drives us to create a positive impact on the world.

We offer purpose-driven and challenging work in diverse international projects, leveraging our 140+ years of expertise. With over 6,800 employees in more than 25 countries, we work together to turn challenges into opportunities and make a real impact on society. We collaborate with leading clients in markets such as infrastructure, climate resilience, renewable energy, decarbonisation of industry, and sustainable mobility.

As our new HV/ MV Electrical Lead Engineer (MCF/ Data Centres) you will become part of our Global Mission Critical Facilities (MCF) team.

Our global MCF team provides multidisciplinary consultancy services to datacentre clients, including colocation datacentres, internet service providers, and telecom companies. The team is diverse, with expertise in areas like electrical and mechanical engineering, construction, architecture, fire safety, control engineering, and security technology. Together, this knowledge is used to develop integrated designs for Data Centres. You will be part of a dedicated, passionate team that is globally recognized as one of the best in Data Centre design and engineering. Curious about our work? Here you will find examples of some of our projects.

The role will be based in our Nijmegen office. As our team is located throughout the EU, travel between offices may be required to meet the project demands. The role may also require occasional travel to client offices/ project sites both in the EU and overseas.

What you bring

You are able to take ownership of complex technical scopes and act confidently in a client facing, advisory role. You communicate clearly, structure complex information effectively and work comfortably across disciplines, organisations and cultural contexts.

In addition, you possess the following:

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering or a related discipline, required to provide the technical depth needed for HV and MV system and substation design;
  • A minimum of 8 years of experience in HV and MV electrical engineering within European projects, needed to independently lead client side, owner engineer and substation related scopes;
  • Proven experience with client-side substation design and grid connections, essential for managing utility interfaces and safeguarding technical quality from the client perspective;
  • Experience with electrical power system studies and review of contractor designs, required to assess risks, validate solutions and support sound decision making;
  • Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken, necessary for effective collaboration with international clients, utilities and multidisciplinary project teams.

What you can expect from us

  • A solid foundation: A competitive base salary (€ 5,468 – € 7,811 p/m), dependent on experience with annual increases;
  • An attractive compensation package: Including a strong pension scheme with an 18.3% employer contribution, a 2.15% personal budget, and annual profit sharing. You will also have the opportunity to purchase company shares and share in our success;
  • Work-life balance: 28 vacation days (based on full-time employment), with the option to purchase an additional 16.5 days per year and to exchange three public holidays for days that are personally meaningful to you. We work in a hybrid model with flexible hours, home office allowance, and a fully equipped home workspace.
  • Development opportunities: A wide range of training and development programs, including tailored learning paths, learning weeks, and various knowledge-sharing groups.
  • Travel allowance: A conveniently located workplace at our office in Nijmegen, with travel expense reimbursement and an NS Business Card. If you walk or bike to work, you will receive a higher travel allowance—encouraging sustainable commuting.
  • Informal and inclusive culture: A welcoming and open environment with voluntary social and sports activities, and employee networks such as Pride and Young Haskoning.

Read more about our employee benefits here.

Are you our new colleague?

Then we would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible.

The application process then consists of two interviews and possibly an assessment. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!

Do you have any questions about the role or the process? You can always contact Wouter Seevinck, Associate Director MEP, at wouter.seevinck@haskoning.comor Christian De Visser, Recruiter Mission Critical Facilities, at christian.de.visser@haskoning.com.

description:
JOIN OUR TEAM as a Trayline/ Dish Machine Operator

Heinzerling Community is seeking compassionate, dedicated Trayline/ Dish Machine Operators who are passionate about enhancing the lives of individuals with developmental disabilities. This is more than a job, you will have the opportunity to build meaningful, lifelong relationships with the residents you support while making a lasting difference every day.

About Us

For more than 60 years, Heinzerling Community has provided exceptional care to children and adults with severe and profound developmental disabilities. As a nonprofit healthcare organization, we are committed to delivering person‑centered care, fostering dignity, and promoting community integration in a nurturing and supportive environment.

Our mission-driven team works together to create enriching experiences and meaningful outcomes for the individuals we serve.

Position Summary

As a Trayline/Dish Machine Operator you'll be at the heart of our kitchen operations, ensuring that residents receive delicious and nourishing meals prepared with care.

Pay Rates & Available Shifts

2nd shift (11a – 7:30p) The base pay is $17.25 per hour, with an additional $1.00/hour shift differential and $2.00/hour weekend shift differential.

Essential Job Duties

  • Prepare food for residents according to specified textures and portion sizes.
  • Prepare formula for residents
  • Maintain cleanliness of kitchen equipment and work area.
  • Operate and maintain dish machine, including washing pots and pans and managing supplies

Requirements

  • Must be able to lift/carry up to 50 pounds regularly and push individuals who weigh up to 200 pounds in wheelchairs.
  • Must be able to regularly use hands to finger, handle, or feel; stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk and hear.
  • Must be able to stay awake for the entire shift.

Excellent Benefits

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • Retirement Plan with generous 50% employer match
  • Tuition Reimbursement opportunities
  • Immediate access to Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Employee Wellness Program with on-site health screenings
  • Employee discounts through the ADP LifeSmart program

Must successfully pass a background check and drug screen

Heinzerling Community is a substance-free workplace and does not accommodate the use of drugs or medical marijuana

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Heinzerling Community is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you're ready to join a compassionate team dedicated to making a difference in the lives of individuals with disabilities, we encourage you to watch our YouTube video Welcome to Heinzerling Community to learn more about our community and apply today!

description:
__________________________________________________________________________________________________

Job Position: Quality Assurance Auditor

Reports to: Quality Assurance Manager

Department: Inserting

Classification: Overtime Eligible

__________________________________________________________________________________________________

PCI Group is the leading provider of mission critical communications for businesses where security of customer-centric data is paramount, precision and accuracy are crucial, and compliance is a must.

Job Summary:
The Quality Assurance (QA) Auditor Technician plays a pivotal role in maintaining PCI Group’s commitment to excellence. This position is responsible for auditing, inspecting, and documenting the internal processes within the Inserting department. The primary objective is to ensure that all products meet our stringent quality standards, and that customers receive flawless output with no variations, defects, or missing components. This role requires a keen eye for detail, a deep understanding of quality assurance principles, and the ability to work collaboratively across teams to drive continuous improvement.

Some General Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Perform audits and visual inspections to ensure printed and inserted materials meet quality and customer specifications.
  • Review job tickets and verify materials, taglines, and sequence numbers for accuracy.
  • Respond to machine quality lights for live divert checks and approve first pieces before full production.
  • Stop production and document any quality defects such as blurry print, missing inserts, or damaged materials.
  • Tag non-conforming products with red HOLD forms and notify appropriate personnel for segregation and review.
  • Complete and follow up on Corrective Action Reports (CARS) and assist with internal and external audit readiness.
  • Verify and record hand-stuff and damage values accurately on QA sheets.
  • Ensure all diverted packages are tracked and reported on Reconciliation Reports.
  • Report quality issues, discrepancies, or procedural gaps to the Quality Assurance Manager or other management.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as directed by the Quality Assurance Manager.

Education/Experience:

  • High School Diploma or G.E.D.; a vocational or technical school diploma or certificate in a related field is preferred.
  • Proficiency in reading and writing English, with the ability to effectively communicate both verbally and in writing.
  • Required background in quality control or quality assurance.
  • Advanced proficiency in MS Office, particularly Word, Excel, and Outlook. Experience with report writing and preparing professional correspondence is required.
  • The candidate should have a working knowledge of report writing, preparing professional verbal and written correspondences and email.
  • Strong computer skills, including the ability to navigate production software, understand workflow processes, and accurately interpret job tickets.


Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representatives of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Frequent hearing and talking required. Must be able to stand and move for long hours May be required to lift up to 40 lbs.

Note: PCI Group retains the discretion to add to or change the duties of this position at any time.

title: Site Reliability Engineer II
description:
About Vista Equity Partners
Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.
Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.

About Amtech
Amtech is scaling its Platform Engineering organization in India as our products move to a fully AWS-hosted, multi-tenant SaaS model. Our SRE practice keeps Encore, LabelTraxx, and supporting platforms reliable, observable, and secure across a multi-account AWS estate.
As a senior individual contributor on the SRE track, you will own the reliability of significant production domains, design the observability and automation frameworks the team standardizes on, and act as incident commander for complex, cross-service incidents.
You will raise the bar for the India SRE pod: setting patterns, reviewing designs, and mentoring earlier-career engineers while remaining deeply hands-on.

Our Employee Value Proposition
At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:

Purpose
Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations.

Growth
Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.

Culture
Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.

Innovation
Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.

Role Description
Amtech is scaling its Platform Engineering organization in India as our products move to a fully AWS-hosted, multi-tenant SaaS model. Our SRE practice keeps Encore, LabelTraxx, and supporting platforms reliable, observable, and secure across a multi-account AWS estate.
As a Platform Engineer on the SRE track, you will build and operate the monitoring, automation, and incident response systems that keep Amtech's services running. You will own defined services end to end, automate away toil, and contribute to reliability standards used by the global team.
This is a hands-on technical role that combines operational discipline with software engineering to drive continuous reliability improvement.

Key Responsibilities
Reliability & Performance

  • Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and reliability tooling on our OpenTelemetry-based stack (OpenObserve, CloudWatch) with PagerDuty for alert routing and escalation.
  • Analyze production performance, capacity, and error budgets to maintain agreed SLIs and SLOs for your services.
  • Implement automated health checks, scaling rules, and self-healing mechanisms to reduce manual intervention.
  • Contribute to root cause analysis and post-incident reviews, driving permanent fixes.

Automation & Operations

  • Build and maintain infrastructure automation in Terraform across Amtech's multi-account AWS organizations.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Operate containerized and serverless workloads on ECS Fargate, EKS, and Lambda, including RDS PostgreSQL-backed services.
  • Implement safe deployment patterns: automated rollbacks, blue/green, and canary releases.

Incident Response & On-Call

  • Participate in the 24/7 PagerDuty on-call rotation and lead response for incidents in your service area.
  • Reduce MTTD and MTTR through proactive automation and observability improvements.
  • Write and maintain runbooks used across the global SRE team.

Security & Compliance

  • Embed security into automation and deployments: IAM design, secrets management, least privilege.
  • Maintain systems in line with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls, producing audit evidence as part of normal operations.

AI Competency

  • Apply AI tools across IaC, pipeline, and automation work with plan review and non-production testing before promotion; understand the blast radius of AI-generated changes.
  • Validate AI output against specifications and standards, including AI-generated tests: review coverage and assertions, not just green results.
  • Use approved tools only and apply Amtech's data classification policy to every AI interaction.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with developers to design services for operability, scalability, and resilience.
  • Coordinate with U.S. and India peers to keep reliability practices consistent globally.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 2-4 years of hands-on experience in SRE, DevOps, or cloud engineering roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate production workloads on AWS (EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC).
  • Working proficiency with Terraform and Git-based CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Solid scripting ability in Python or Bash applied to real automation problems.
  • Experience with modern observability practices (metrics, logs, traces) and tools such as OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Prometheus, or Grafana.
  • Understanding of SLO/SLI-driven operations and structured incident management.
  • Sound grasp of networking, DNS, and cloud security fundamentals.
  • Disciplined AI-assisted engineering practice: structured prompting, output validation, and awareness of where AI-generated code fails.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, DevOps Engineer, CKA/CKAD, or Terraform Associate.
  • Experience supporting multi-tenant SaaS or account-per-customer AWS architectures.
  • Exposure to PagerDuty or equivalent incident management platforms.
  • Experience operating AI/LLM-backed services or building agentic automation under governance controls.

Why Join Amtech

At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

Location-Dade City

description:
Location: Singapore Employment Type: Full-time Department: App Ecosystem Center — Platform Product Group, Data Product Team

Role Overview We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to build and own the data infrastructure that powers company-wide decision making. This role works with de-identified app data and serves markets outside of China, ensuring every number our teams see is consistent, trustworthy, and well-explained. You will design our warehouse architecture, define the metrics that the entire business runs on, and establish a single source of truth that ends cross-team disagreements over 'whose number is right.'

Who You'll Work With • Reports to: Data Product Lead (China HQ) or Regional Tech Lead • Collaborates with: Product managers, operations teams, customer support, data engineering team (HQ), and regional engineering teams • Team context: Bridges business stakeholders and engineering; works across regions with China HQ data platform team

Responsibilities • Design and build a standardized four-layer warehouse architecture (ODS / DWD / DWS / ADS) on StarRocks, Hive, and related big-data components • Model core business dimensions including user, device, campaign, app version, region, and acquisition channel, enabling layered reuse of detail-level data, aggregated data, and application metrics • Map core business scenarios and build a company-wide standardized metrics framework; own canonical definitions for key metrics — user activity (DAU/WAU/MAU), PV/UV, retention, funnel conversion, campaign GMV, device error rate — including calculation rules, dimensions, and documentation • Build and maintain the semantic layer to unify metric definitions, dimension semantics, and business logic, shielding business users from underlying warehouse complexity • Establish end-to-end data governance mechanisms covering event-tracking review, data validation, dirty-data cleansing, definition iteration, anomaly monitoring, and alerting • Continuously reduce the share of invalid and anomalous data; keep pipelines stable, trustworthy, and fully traceable

Requirements • Bachelor's degree or above in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience • 3+ years of experience in data platform, analytics engineering, or data science at internet companies • Proven ability to build a business data system from 0 to 1, covering the full lifecycle: tracking plan design → event dictionary → dimensional modeling → semantic layer → metrics framework → data governance • Hands-on experience abstracting business semantics, unifying dimensions, and driving metric standardization to production • Legally authorized to work in Singapore; this role does not provide visa sponsorship

title: Senior Data scientist / ML Engineer
description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving


Sopra Steria biedt op maat gemaakte end-to-end corporate technology- en softwareoplossingen die organisaties helpen gedurfde keuzes te maken en meetbare resultaten te boeken. Met meer dan 51.000 collega’s in bijna 30 landen behoren we tot de top van de Europese leveranciers van digitale oplossingen. Succesvolle organisaties in Europa vertrouwen op onze technologie vanwege onze voortdurende focus op innovatie, samenwerking en zakelijke ontwikkeling. The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.


Vacatureomschrijving


Je kan waardevolle inzichten halen uit grote datasets. Als Data Scientist ontfutsel je deze door je vloeiend kennis van programmeertalen als Python en R en visualisatietools als Tableau en PowerBI. Je kan die inzichten communiceren naar stakeholders zodat ze de nodige stappen kunnen zetten. Onze data scientists zijn vaardig in Hadoop & Spark en cloudplatformen als AWS en Azure. Deze tools – samen met je data expertise – zorgen ervoor dat het bouwen van voorspellende modellen, het uitvoeren van hypothesis tests en het uitvoeren van verkennende data-analyse je heel natuurlijk af gaan.

Als Data Engineer zal je:

  • ruwe data omzetten in bruikbare inzichten en
  • schaalbare oplossingen
  • je richten op het ontwerp en de optimalisatie
  • van data-infrastructuur
  • processen automatiseren
  • zorgen voor een naadloze levering van data
  • microservices ontwikkelen om data lakes
  • toegankelijker en nuttiger te maken

Je zoekt steeds naar innovatieve manieren om de schaalbaarheid en bruikbaarheid van data te verbeteren. Van de eerste conceptontwikkeling tot de uiteindelijke implementatie—jij ontwikkelt en implementeert data oplossingen die sterke resultaten opleveren en de strategische doelen van onze klanten ondersteunen.


Functie-eisen


We zijn op zoek naar gepassioneerde collega’s die graag de grenzen willen verleggen op het gebied van digitale transformatie en technologie consulting. Bij Sopra Steria krijg je de kans om te werken aan impactvolle projecten en je vaardigheden te ontwikkelen in een constructieve teamomgeving. Jij wilt tot de besten behoren. Dat is waarom jij altijd naar manieren zoekt om jouw kennis uit te breiden en op de hoogte te blijven van de laatste trends en ontwikkelingen. Hou je van een uitdaging en vind je jezelf in (de meeste van) deze criteria? Dan kijken we nu al uit naar jouw sollicitatie.

Type werk: Hybrid

Locatie: Groningen, NL

Contracturen: 36-40

Type contract: Vast

Opleiding: HBO, WO, PhD

Ervaring: 7+ jaar

Talen: Nederlands

Je hebt kennis en ervaring in:

Need: Python, SQL, cloud platform (Azure, AWS, GCP), git, docker, Specialisatie(e.g. Tabular ML, Computer vision, NLP, Deep Learning), coaching, project management, Verantwoorde AI kennis, MLOps/DevOps

Nice to have: BI, R, Databricks, wiskundige optimalisatie, big data/distributed computing, ETL/ELT, Presentatie vaardigheden


Aanvullende informatie


Je zal deel uitmaken van een grote naam in de tech wereld die bekend is om consulting, digitale diensten en softwareontwikkeling. Je begeeft je tussen high-level professionals die durven in te zetten om hoge resultaten te behalen.

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

• Een vast contract.

keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto met NS Business Card of leasefiets of een alternatief vervoersregeling – net wat het beste bij jouw manier van reizen past;

• 27 betaalde vakantiedagen;

• Flex benefit van € 1.800, - per jaar met daar bovenop een extra percentage van jouw salaris. Dit budget kan worden gebruikt voor zaken als aankoop van extra vrije dagen of extra sparen in jouw pensioenregeling;

• Thuiskantoor met laptop, telefoon en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding;

title: Manager, Electronics & Firmware
description:
The Manager, Electronics & Firmware will lead the design, development, integration, and commercialization of electronics and embedded firmware platforms supporting Cytek's next-generation flow cytometry and imaging instrumentation.

This role combines people leadership with hands-on technical leadership, guiding a team of electrical and firmware engineers through product development from architecture and feasibility through verification, manufacturing transfer, and sustaining support. The ideal candidate brings expertise in mixed-signal electronics, embedded systems, FPGA-based data acquisition, real-time instrument control, and scientific instrumentation.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform essential duties and responsibilities satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Engineering Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of electrical and firmware engineers.
  • Establish engineering priorities, technical roadmaps, and development plans aligned with product objectives.
  • Drive execution through effective project planning, technical reviews, and engineering best practices.
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Electronics & Firmware Development

  • Lead architecture and development of electronic subsystems including PCBAs, embedded processors, FPGAs, GPUs, detector interfaces, data acquisition hardware, communications interfaces, and instrument control electronics.
  • Oversee development of embedded firmware supporting instrument control, data acquisition, signal processing, diagnostics, calibration, and automated quality control.
  • Manage development of GPU-accelerated and CUDA-based solutions supporting image acquisition, feature extraction, real-time processing, and scientific data analysis workflows.
  • Guide schematic capture, component selection, PCB design reviews, and design-for-manufacturing and design-for-test activities.
  • Drive hardware and firmware integration, debugging, performance optimization, and root-cause investigations.
  • Establish subsystem requirements, interface definitions, verification strategies, and technical design standards.

System Integration & Product Development

  • Partner with optical, mechanical, fluidics, software, systems, scientific, and product management teams to deliver integrated instrument solutions.
  • Lead prototype bring-up, subsystem integration, verification, validation, and manufacturing transfer activities.
  • Support production test development, engineering builds, pilot production, and sustaining engineering efforts.
  • Collaborate with Operations and NPI teams to improve product quality, reliability, manufacturability, and serviceability.

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the primary technical escalation point for complex electronics and firmware challenges.
  • Drive innovation in detector electronics, signal acquisition, embedded control systems, imaging systems, and scientific instrumentation.

description:
Who We Are

AMPAM Parks Mechanical specializes in multifamily residential construction. The company’s core strength is its design-build model that allows clients to minimize risk, shorten construction schedules, and accelerate building occupancy.

What We're Looking For

The Superintendent plays a key role in leading Coastal Fire and Integration Systems' onsite presence for the project, overseeing scheduling, safety, quality control, and team supervision. This position focuses on jobsite leadership, compliance, and coordination, partnering with the Project Manager, jobsite Superintendent, subcontractors, and local officials to ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, and within scope. The ideal candidate is safety-minded, detail-oriented, and committed to strong onsite leadership.

What You'll be Doing

(But not limited to the following)

  • Assume Coastal Fire and Integration Systems leadership role for the project
  • Manage and ensure proper implementation and compliance with all Coastal Fire and Integration Systems policies and procedures
  • Supervise and manage all team members
  • Conduct safety meetings and safety inspections, and report any employee not following required safety practices on a job; stay aware of dangers specific to certain tasks and make employees aware of those dangers
  • Conduct meetings at the jobsite weekly to cover issues related to the job
  • Prepare for and participate in scheduling meetings
  • Oversee and implement the Near Term Schedule
  • Complete Daily Diary
  • Review, approve, and follow up on field orders
  • Verify onsite regularly, verify receipt by Thursday noon, finish all outstanding issues by Monday, and approve employee time sheets
  • Manage jobsite clean up, security, and the quality control program
  • Develop and maintain relationships with the Jobsite Superintendent, other subcontractors onsite, local inspection officials, and Coastal Fire and Integration Systems staff related to the project
  • Review the project material/submittal status with the Construction Manager weekly
  • Complete billing request forms as needed by the billing department
  • Manage project risk to ensure Coastal Fire and Integration Systems' profit goals are met and adhere to the spirit of the contract as agreed to by the Coastal Fire Project Manager
  • Maintain red-lines on as-built documents and turn in red-lines at job completion to the Coastal Fire Project Manager
  • Keep a current two-week look-ahead posted at all times on the board in the construction office
  • Manage critical situations involving employees, such as accidents, and connect employees with the appropriate personnel to resolve the situation
  • Manage changes to the layout of equipment in the field, obtain initialed approval from parties with change authority, and immediately return the information to the Project Manager for a cost impact analysis
  • Order material required to complete work per scope and ensure it is onsite prior to work starting

Who You Are

  • Experience:
    • Prior experience as a construction Superintendent or in a similar jobsite leadership role
    • State Fire Alarm certification (Blue Card) required
    • Working knowledge of jobsite scheduling, safety requirements, and quality control processes
  • Skills:
    • Strong leadership and team supervision skills
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities and critical situations in a fast-paced jobsite environment
    • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills

Position Scope

This position is designed as a leadership-focused Superintendent role responsible for onsite project execution, safety compliance, scheduling, and team supervision. The Superintendent works closely with the Project Manager and jobsite partners but does not have full ownership of contract negotiation or enterprise-level decision-making responsibilities.

The Superintendent is critical to ensuring safe, on-schedule, and compliant project delivery by maintaining strong jobsite leadership and supporting continuous coordination across the project team.

description:

title: VICE PRESIDENT OF REAL ESTATE
location: PSN Service LLC, Plano, TX, US
description:
About Legent Health

At Legent Health, our mission is simple yet profound: “To provide first-class health care that puts YOU first.”

Our vision reflects our commitment to excellence: “Through robust physician partnerships, become a nationwide leader in compassionate, quality healthcare focused on the patient and available to everyone.”

Our values, also known as our brand pillars, define how we stay true to our identity in the healthcare industry and the communities we serve. These values are central to everything we do:

  • Respect: We honor the time and trust of both patients and physicians by delivering organized, efficient services that ensure a seamless healthcare experience.
  • Service: We are committed to highly personalized care for patients, their families, and the physicians who serve them, driving optimal outcomes for all.
  • Leadership: We strive to be a trusted leader through innovation, clear communication, and unwavering dedication to excellence across our employees and partners.

Joining Legent Health means being part of a team that lives these principles every day, as we build a future focused on compassionate, quality care.

About the Role

The Vice President of Real Estate is a strategic executive leader responsible for all aspects of Legent Health's real estate portfolio, including the identification, negotiation, and execution of real estate transactions, de novo facility development, leasing and optimization of company-owned properties, and the remodeling of existing facilities to support new service lines or bring acquired sites into full code and regulatory compliance. This role carries full fiscal accountability for developing and maintaining accurate budgets across all real estate and facilities initiatives, with an expectation of delivering projects within established financial parameters. This role serves as a key member of the leadership team, partnering closely with the Chief Strategy Officer to align real estate strategy with the organization's long-term growth objectives.

The VP of Real Estate provides enterprise-wide leadership to the Facilities and Project Management teams, ensuring that all properties and construction initiatives are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with Legent Health's clinical, operational, and financial standards.

POSITION’S ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

Real Estate Strategy & Transactions

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive real estate strategy aligned with Legent Health's growth, network expansion, and market penetration goals.
  • Lead the identification, evaluation, and negotiation of real estate acquisitions, dispositions, joint ventures, and partnership opportunities.
  • Conduct market analysis and site selection assessments to identify optimal locations for new facilities and service lines.
  • Manage due diligence processes including financial modeling, zoning review, environmental assessments, and legal coordination.
  • Build and maintain relationships with brokers, developers, landlords, lenders, and other key real estate stakeholders.

De Novo Facility Development

  • Oversee the full lifecycle of de novo (ground-up) facility builds from site selection and feasibility analysis through construction completion and occupancy.
  • Partner with clinical, operational, and finance leadership to define facility requirements, space programming, and design standards.
  • Manage general contractors, architects, engineers, and other third-party vendors throughout the development process.
  • Ensure all de novo projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and compliant with applicable regulations and licensing requirements.
  • Monitor construction milestones, manage risk, and proactively resolve issues that may impact project delivery.

Leasing & Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the leasing of Legent Health-owned properties, including negotiating lease terms, renewals, and tenant relationships.
  • Manage the company's real estate portfolio to maximize asset utilization, minimize vacancy, and generate revenue from underutilized properties.
  • Develop and maintain a portfolio dashboard tracking lease expiration, financial performance, capital expenditure, and occupancy metrics.
  • Evaluate lease versus own decisions for existing and prospective locations in alignment with financial and strategic goals.
  • Coordinate with legal counsel on lease agreements, purchase contracts, title matters, and real estate-related compliance.

Facility Remodeling & Code Compliance

  • Lead planning and execution of remodeling initiatives for existing facilities requiring updates due to the introduction of new service lines, ensuring spaces meet clinical, operational, and regulatory standards.
  • Oversee code compliance remediation efforts for acquired facilities that do not meet applicable federal, state, or local building, fire, life safety, or healthcare regulatory requirements at the time of acquisition.
  • Conduct or commission facility condition assessments and code gap analyses for all acquired properties to develop prioritized remediation roadmaps.
  • Partner with Clinical, Operations, and Compliance leadership to define remodeling scope, functional requirements, and timelines driven by new service line activations.
  • Manage architects, engineers, contractors, and permitting agencies through all phases of remodel and code compliance projects, ensuring timely licensure and certificate of occupancy.
  • Develop and manage capital budgets for remodeling and code remediation projects, providing regular financial reporting to senior leadership.
  • Maintain current knowledge of applicable codes and standards, including ADA, NFPA, The Joint Commission Environment of Care standards, CMS Conditions of Participation, and state health facility licensing requirements.

Facilities Management

  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight to the Facilities team responsible for maintenance, operations, safety, and environmental standards across all Legent Health locations.
  • Ensure all facilities are maintained in full regulatory compliance, including Joint Commission, CMS, OSHA, and applicable state requirements.
  • Champion a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement within the Facilities function.
  • Oversee capital planning for facility improvements, deferred maintenance, and equipment lifecycle management.

Project Management

  • Lead the Project Management team responsible for delivering real estate, construction, renovation, and facilities improvement projects across the organization.
  • Establish and maintain standardized project management methodologies, reporting frameworks, and governance practices.
  • Ensure visibility and accountability on all active projects through regular executive-level reporting on cost, schedule, and scope.
  • Drive operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to standardize, streamline, and scale project delivery capabilities.

Budget Development & Fiscal Accountability

  • Develop comprehensive, accurate budgets for all real estate, construction, remodeling, facilities, and project management initiatives, ensuring estimates are thoroughly researched, realistic, and account for all anticipated costs including contingencies.
  • Maintain strict adherence to established budgets throughout the lifecycle of every project — cost overruns require executive-level justification and approval; under-budgeting that misrepresents true project costs is not acceptable.
  • Ensure all budget submissions reflect complete and honest cost projections; budgets must not be artificially reduced to gain approval, as accurate forecasting is essential to sound organizational financial planning.
  • Implement rigorous financial tracking and reporting processes to monitor actual spend versus budget on a regular basis, providing timely and transparent updates to senior leadership on variances.
  • Proactively identify financial risks to active projects and develop mitigation strategies to prevent cost escalation before issues materialize.
  • Partner with Finance leadership on annual capital and operating budget planning cycles, providing accurate multi-year forecasts for the full real estate and facilities portfolio.
  • Evaluate vendor proposals, contracts, and change orders with a disciplined focus on cost management and value, ensuring competitive pricing and sound financial stewardship.
  • Maintain accountability for departmental operating budgets across Real Estate, Facilities, and Project Management functions.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the Chief Strategy Officer and senior leadership team on all matters related to real estate and facilities.
  • Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing team across Real Estate, Facilities, and Project Management functions.
  • Collaborate with Finance, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Clinical leadership to ensure alignment on all real estate and capital initiatives.
  • Prepare and present real estate strategy, project updates, and portfolio performance to executive leadership and the Board as required.
  • Manage departmental budgets, including operating expense and capital expenditure planning and forecasting.
  • Set clear goals and expectations; provide regular coaching, feedback, and performance reviews.
  • Develop talent through mentoring, training, and career development initiatives.
  • Promote a collaborative and engaging work environment that aligns with company values.
  • Manage conflict and make timely decisions to maintain team focus and performance.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance reviews, and development conversations.
  • Approve timecards, schedules, time-off requests, and other administrative HR functions.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, labor laws, and safety regulations.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Business Administration, Finance, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field required.
  • Master's degree (MBA or equivalent) or advanced degree in a relevant discipline strongly preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive real estate and facilities leadership experience, with at least 5 years in a senior or executive-level role.
  • Demonstrated experience in healthcare real estate, medical office development, or multi-site healthcare facility management strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record of successfully executing complex real estate transactions, including acquisitions, dispositions, and ground-up development projects.
  • Experience managing and leading cross-functional teams including facilities operations and project management professionals.

Why Join Legent Health?

Legent Health fosters an environment where team members are empowered to deliver exceptional care while growing professionally within a supportive, values-driven culture.

We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and performance incentives
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Paid time off and wellness programs
  • Career development and training opportunities

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Legent Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

I-9 and E-Verify Compliance:
Employment eligibility will be verified through the U.S. Department of Homeland Security’s E-Verify system. All applicants must provide valid documentation to establish identity and authorization to work in the United States, as required by federal law.

title: Evaluation Associate
description:
Position Summary

The Data and Evaluation Associate's primary responsibilities are to: 1) prepare regular reports on key programs to for program leaders and administrators; 2) support the design of rigorous mixed methods program and agency evaluations (integrating qualitative and quantitative data); 3) help design and administer program evaluation tools that measure program compliance and quality; 4) monitor programs' quality and compliance; 5) analyze administrative, compliance, and quality data; 6) design, test, and administer stakeholder surveys. The Associate will divide their time equally between PMT. where they will be supervised by a Data and Evaluation Manager, and the Mayor's Office of Education (MOE), where they will work on-site with program staff.

Essential Functions

1) Support the design and implementation of research and evaluation projects that advance program and system performance improvements for Adult Education, Extended Day Extended Year and other MOE programs.

2) Clean, manage, and integrate data from key system sources to produce short and long-term outcome analyses. Key data sources include but are not limited to case file reviews, program narratives, program observations, surveys, and administrative data on enrollment, attendance, invoicing, activities and outcomes.

3) Prepare and submit quarterly MOE data reports for internal and public audiences.

4) Generate graphs, tables, and other data visuals.

5) Assist in survey design, administration, and analysis.

6) Automate regular data reporting of administrative, compliance, and quality data.

7) Monitor contract compliance by coding and maintaining provider-specific automated monthly reports.

8) Craft novel, exploratory reports of learning, achievement, and demographic data to support the conception and articulation of MOE's network-wide strategies.

9) Support Adult Education (AEPHL) Continuous Quality Improvement (CQ) process.

a. Monitor and support the collection Of program evaluation data using CQI tools across the AEPHL network of adult education providers.

b. Clean, analyze, and disseminate provider-level CQI data for AEPHL network partners.

c. Analyze CQ and evaluation data in aggregate to communicate trends in program improvement to all MOE and AEPHL stakeholders.

10) Support the strategic planning, facilitation, and day-to-day management of the Continuous Program Improvement Collaborative (CPIC), a yearlong professional development initiative that equips adult education providers to collect, monitor, and analyze data to inform continuous program improvement and decision-making.

11) Ensure transparency and accountability in service provider communications through consistent external reporting and the solicitation of provider stakeholder input and feedback.

12) Advise teammates on measurement and evaluation processes, including formulating research questions, planning the scope of evaluation, and developing feedback cycles between data collection and data analysis.

13) Develop written reports and presentations for a variety of audiences using clear, concise language.

14) Perform related research and evaluation duties as assigned.

15) Work collaboratively with PMT team members to ensure quality implementation of performance management activities and processes.

16) Ensure data project requirements are achieved in a timely fashion.

17) Other duties as assigned.

Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Quantitative:

• Knowledge of statistical and survey software such as R, STATA, SPSS, and Qualtrics.

• Knowledge of survey design, programming, and administration.

• Strong research, analysis, and writing skills. Clear and concise communication of ideas, program scopes, and findings — orally and in writing.

• Reflective and seeks feedback.

• Exceptional cultural competency and proficiency.

Qualitative:

• Prior experience conducting interviews, focus groups, and observations

• Prior experience analyzing qualitative data, including coding interviews, focus groups, and observations and conducting document reviews

title: Director of Facilities
description:
Unusual Machines is a U.S.-based drone and drone parts company focused on the small and First-Person View (FPV) segments of the drone market. Our brands - Rotor Riot, Fat Shark, Rotor Lab and - coming soon - Upgrade Energy - are some of the most respected names in FPV and have helped shape the industry through e-commerce, product development, and a deep connection with the pilot community.

We’re expanding into enterprise and defense - bringing our obsessive attention to performance, design, and U.S.-based manufacturing into high-stakes environments like search and rescue and military innovation. With several of our products already approved by the Defense Innovation Unit, we’re solving procurement issues for customers who demand speed, agility, and compliance.

If you love working at the intersection of community, content, and cutting-edge technology, you’ll feel right at home here.

Director of Facilities

You in This Role are an experienced facilities leader who thrives in fast-growth, operationally complex environments and knows how to bring structure, organization, and scalability to rapidly evolving operations. You are equally comfortable leading expansion projects and buildouts as you are walking facilities, solving operational issues in real time, managing vendors, improving preventative maintenance programs, and helping teams stay ahead of growth. You know how to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution, communicate proactively, and operate with urgency in environments where priorities can shift quickly. Most importantly, you are a visible leader and strong coach who can develop people, build scalable processes, and help create the operational backbone needed to support a rapidly growing manufacturing organization.

A Day in the Life

No two days will look exactly the same in this role. One morning may involve walking a manufacturing facility to address operational concerns, reviewing preventative maintenance priorities, and coordinating security vendor updates. The afternoon may involve touring a potential new facility, meeting with contractors on a buildout timeline, troubleshooting parking and occupancy challenges, or partnering with HR and Operations on expansion planning.

You will regularly:

  • Lead facilities operations across multiple Orlando-area locations
  • Coordinate expansions, buildouts, moves, and space planning
  • Manage landlord, broker, contractor, and vendor relationships
  • Improve facilities processes and preventative maintenance programs
  • Oversee physical security systems, access control, visitor management, and emergency preparedness coordination
  • Partner cross-functionally with HR, Operations, Manufacturing, and Finance
  • Coach and develop the Facilities Manager and broader Facilities team
  • Prioritize and resolve reactive operational issues quickly and effectively
  • Help create scalable systems that support continued company growth

This role requires someone who can zoom out strategically while still staying close to day-to-day execution.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead all facilities-related operations across corporate, warehouse, manufacturing, and fulfillment locations
  • Oversee facilities expansion projects, renovations, buildouts, and occupancy planning
  • Manage lease coordination activities in partnership with the company’s Realtor of record
  • Lead vendor management efforts, including janitorial, maintenance, security, HVAC, electrical, utilities, and construction-related vendors
  • Develop scalable preventative maintenance and facilities management processes
  • Oversee physical security operations, including badge/access systems, visitor management, and facility security coordination
  • Partner with leadership on space planning, parking logistics, and future facilities growth needs
  • Manage facilities budgets, invoice approvals, and vendor negotiations
  • Support emergency preparedness planning and overall facility readiness
  • Partner with HR and Operations on company events, facility logistics, and employee experience initiatives
  • Coordinate move management and new site readiness activities
  • Ensure facilities remain safe, functional, organized, and operationally effective as the company scales
  • Develop and coach the Facilities Manager while helping build long-term team capabilities
  • Help create accountability, communication, and ownership across facilities operations

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of facilities leadership experience in manufacturing, warehouse, logistics, distribution, or fast-growth operational environments
  • Experience leading facilities operations across multiple sites
  • Strong construction, expansion, and buildout coordination experience
  • Experience managing vendors, contractors, landlords, and facility-related partnerships
  • Strong understanding of:
    • HVAC systems
    • Electrical systems
    • Warehouse/manufacturing infrastructure
    • Access control/security systems
    • Preventative maintenance programs
    • Fire/life safety systems
  • Experience operating in fast-growth or rapidly changing environments
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills
  • High sense of urgency and operational responsiveness
  • Proven ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution
  • Strong leadership and team development capabilities
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to independently prioritize and lead facilities operations with limited direction

Strongly Preferred

  • Manufacturing and warehouse environment experience
  • Security and safety oversight experience
  • Experience supporting rapid expansion and multi-site growth
  • Startup or high-growth company experience
  • Experience scaling facilities infrastructure while processes are still evolving

What You’ll Gain

  • The opportunity to help shape the infrastructure of a rapidly scaling manufacturing company
  • A highly visible operational leadership role with meaningful impact
  • The ability to build systems, processes, and facilities strategy from the ground up
  • A fast-paced environment where decisions move quickly and your work directly affects company growth
  • A collaborative leadership team focused on scaling aggressively and building for the future

Compensation & Benefits - $135,000 - $150,000

The People

At Unusual Machines, we are building something ambitious. We move quickly, solve problems in real time, and continue scaling while building infrastructure around us.

The people who succeed here are adaptable, accountable, collaborative, operationally minded, and willing to step in wherever needed to help the organization grow.

We are not looking for someone to simply maintain facilities. We are looking for someone who can help scale them.

One More Thing

Facilities emergencies do not always happen on a schedule, and growth at UMAC is not slowing down anytime soon.

This role requires someone who is energized by solving problems, building systems, supporting teams, and helping create operational stability inside a rapidly evolving environment.

If you enjoy building while flying, creating order from growth, and helping shape the future of a scaling organization, we would love to meet you.

Benefits

  • Equity
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • 401(k)
  • Generous PTO
  • Paid Holidays
  • Daily Catered Lunches

title: Pensionär sökes till lageruppdrag i Kista
description:
Känner du att du fortfarande har både erfarenhet och arbetsglädje kvar att bidra med? Då kan det här vara ett uppdrag som passar dig. Vi söker en lagerarbetare som vill vara en del av ett härligt team och hjälpa till med inventering och lagerarbete några dagar i månaden. Här möts du av god gemenskap, varierande arbetsuppgifter och en arbetsplats där erfarenhet värdesätts.

Om uppdraget

Vi söker dig som vill bidra med din erfarenhet inom lager och logistik i ett långsiktigt och flexibelt uppdrag.

Arbetsuppgifterna består främst av inventering, enklare lagerplock och att bidra till att lagret hålls organiserat och välfungerande. Här finns möjlighet att arbeta självständigt samtidigt som du ingår i ett team med god gemenskap och nära samarbete.

Om företaget

Uppdraget utförs hos ett privatägt grossistföretag inom byggbranschen. Företaget präglas av en familjär känsla, högt i tak och en stark laganda. Här finns ett glatt gäng som trivs tillsammans och där erfarenhet, engagemang och samarbete värdesätts högt.

Vem vi tror passar för rollen

Du har tidigare erfarenhet från lagerarbete, logistik eller liknande verksamhet och känner dig bekväm i en lagermiljö. Du trivs med praktiskt arbete, har ett öga för ordning och struktur och gillar att få saker gjorda. Med din erfarenhet bidrar du till att arbetet flyter på smidigt och du uppskattar både självständigt arbete och samarbetet med kollegor.

Har du truckkort, kunskaper i engelska eller erfarenhet av affärssystemet Pyramid är det ett plus, men inget krav. Det som värderas högst är din erfarenhet, din positiva inställning och viljan att bidra där det behövs.

Vi förstår vikten av flexibilitet och anpassar våra uppdrag så att du kan njuta av din pension samtidigt som du får lön för att sätta guldkant på tillvaron med. title: Workload Placement Engineer
description:
Job Title:- Workload Placement Engineer

Location:- Mexico (Prefered)/Latam (Remote)

Duration:- Contract


Job Description :


Job Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated Workload Placement Engineer to support enterprise workload placement, workload migration and overall cloud adoption. This role will be responsible for assessing application portfolios, performing cloud suitability evaluations, conducting dependency analysis, and migrating workloads across cloud, on-premises, edge, colocation, and SaaS solutions.

The Workload Placement Engineer will partner with application owners, enterprise architects, infrastructure teams, security teams, and business stakeholders to ensure workloads are placed in the most appropriate hosting environment based on business, technical, operational, financial, and compliance requirements.

The ideal candidate combines cloud knowledge, application assessment experience, and strong analytical skills to drive informed workload placement decisions and accelerate modernization and migration programs.


Key Responsibilities

Workload Assessment & Placement

  • Conduct workload discovery and assessment activities across application portfolios.
  • Perform cloud suitability assessments and disposition analysis using established decision frameworks.
  • Evaluate workload characteristics, dependencies, business criticality, security, compliance, and performance requirements.
  • Recommend workload placement options including Cloud, SaaS, Colocation, On-Premises, Edge, or Hybrid environments.
  • Document placement decisions, rationale, risks, and assumptions.

Application Dependency Mapping & Analysis

  • Analyze application dependencies using CMDB, monitoring tools, discovery platforms, and stakeholder interviews.
  • Validate upstream and downstream application relationships.
  • Support dependency-based grouping and migration wave planning.
  • Identify potential migration blockers, integration risks, and remediation requirements.
  • Maintain workload inventory and dependency repositories.

Migration Readiness & Modernization Support

  • Support migration planning and readiness assessments.
  • Assist application teams in understanding modernization opportunities and disposition options (6R’s).
  • Participate in migration wave planning and prioritization activities.
  • Align workload requirements with target landing zones and platform capabilities.
  • Support tracking and reporting of migration readiness metrics.

Governance & Standards

  • Ensure workload placement recommendations align with Enterprise Architecture standards and approved technology patterns.
  • Collaborate with Security, Infrastructure, Compliance, EA, FinOps, and Platform Engineering teams.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and workload placement governance processes.
  • Support exceptions management and documentation.
  • Contribute to workload placement standards, decision trees, and guidance documentation.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Maintain workload assessment data and placement decisions.

title: Dog Care Technician (Full-Time)
description:
JOB TITLE: Animal Care Technician (Dog Team)

DEPARTMENT: Shelter Operations

ACCOUNTABILITY: Animal Care Manager

SCHEDULE: Full-Time shifts are 7:00am to 4:00pm unless otherwise assigned. Flexibility in scheduling is a must. This position will include weekend and holiday work.


FUNCTION: Under direct responsibility of the Animal Care Manager, the primary responsibilities include daily feeding of animals, cleaning of animal housing areas, monitoring, and reporting on the medical and behavioral health of the animals, providing mental and physical exercise to the animals, and general cleaning and upkeep of facilities and equipment. Animal Care team members are also responsible for the deep cleaning of our crates, traps, and equipment and are required to assist with laundry and dishes as needed.


Why Join RHSPCA?

We're a forward-thinking, optimistic team that values attention to detail, collaboration, and passionate care. If you enjoy working with talented people and want your work to make a tangible difference every day, we'd love to hear from you.

Staff Perks

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • PTO with increases every other year as well as time off for bereavement and your birthday
  • Employer sponsored life insurance
  • Supplemental insurance offerings (Short-Term Disability, Critical Care, Accident, Cancer, and Hospital Indemnity)
  • All employees with the RHSPCA can take advantage of the Hill’s Pro Staff Feeding program, which offers significant discounts on their products.
  • Discount offerings to multiple businesses throughout the valley
  • Staff and volunteer appreciation events
  • $0 adoption fee on your first pet adopted through the RHSPCA


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

General:

  1. Perform duties in a manner which encourages attainment of RHSPCA goals.
  2. Work courteously and cooperatively with the staff, volunteers, fosters, and the public.
  3. Follow all RHSPCA policies and procedures, prioritizing people’s safety and animal wellbeing.
  4. Ensure quality care and humane treatment for the animals owned by the RHSPCA.
  5. Participates in meetings with other staff members and shares ideas and suggestions designed to improve working conditions, welfare of pets and the organization.


Communication:

  1. Provide excellent people service and engagement to staff, volunteers, and the public alike.
  2. Communicate effectively, written, and oral, to ensure pertinent information is exchanged in a productive and professional manner.
  3. Proficiency with email and ability keep themselves abreast of new information shared via email.
  4. Appropriately utilizes the shelter software to ensure thoroughness and completeness of animal records and to document health and behavioral concerns.


Animal Care & Husbandry:

  1. Responsible for cleaning of animal areas, equipment, general facilities cleaning and laundry per operational guidelines.
  2. Practice safe and humane treatment of animals with interactions geared towards improving adoptability of the animals.
  3. Provide for the medical and behavioral needs of the animals as instructed.
  4. Provides proper care and feeding of pets in assigned areas as directed by Animal Care Manager and indicated in the Standard Operating Procedures.
  5. Notify appropriate staff of repairs and maintenance needed on premises and assist with such repairs and maintenance as needed.
  6. Report any health, behavioral and safety concerns of animals being cared for. Monitors and reports changes in disposition and health daily.


Volunteers

  1. Engage volunteers and share knowledge with them to best utilize their time with the RHSPCA.


Perform other duties as assigned.


TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE

RHSPCA is seeking a hardworking, honest and resourceful person to help us provide excellent care for the animals in our care. The right person for this role should have commitment to and enthusiasm for our mission. Good time management and oral and written communication skills, the ability to work well with others and a desire to learn are a must.

High school diploma or equivalent preferred. Previous experience working with animals is not required.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Ability to lift 35 lbs., stand for long periods of time, move quickly, work with and around animals (including diseased, injured and/or potentially aggressive animals), loud noises, chlorine or other chemicals, inclement weather along with evening, weekend and holiday work times.


COMPENSATION

This is an hourly position offering a starting rate of $15/hr. After a period of employment, the Animal Care Technician is eligible for health benefits and PTO.


NATURE OF EMPLOYMENT

There is no minimum period of employment guaranteed or implied by acceptance of an offer of employment. It is the policy of the RHSPCA that employment for this position is at will, which means that employment for no specified term and the employee or agency may terminate that employment at any time without cause. This job description serves as a guide.

description:
Job Description

Job ID: MJ000353

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help build and scale the data foundations supporting our business. You will work on complex data warehouse architecture, pipeline development and migration, data quality, and analytics enablement.

This role is suited for someone who enjoys solving large-scale data problems end-to-end — from designing robust data models and pipelines to ensuring trusted, consistent data can be easily consumed across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and evolve scalable data warehouse architecture and data models, including raw, staging, core/conformed, and mart layers. Develop and maintain reliable batch and/or streaming data pipelines, ensuring scalability, performance, and data quality. Drive the migration and consolidation of legacy data pipelines and platforms, including validation, reconciliation, cutover, and decommissioning. Establish consistent data definitions, metrics, and modelling standards across business domains. Build data quality frameworks covering automated testing, freshness monitoring, anomaly detection, and reconciliation. Partner closely with Analytics, BI, Product, Engineering, and business teams to translate data requirements into scalable solutions and enable self-service analytics. Improve data discoverability and usability through certified datasets, documentation, semantic models, and reusable data assets. Contribute to engineering best practices through architecture/design reviews, technical standards, and mentoring of other Data Engineers.

Requirements

Minimum 7+ years of Data Engineering experience, building and operating large-scale data systems. Expert knowledge of data warehousing methodologies (Dimensional Modeling, Star/Snowflake Schema, Data Vault). Hands-on experience with modern big data stacks: Hive, Spark, Flink, Kafka. Deep familiarity with cutting-edge OLAP engines and lakehouse technologies: ClickHouse, StarRocks, Greenplum, Iceberg, or Hudi. Strong proficiency in advanced SQL, query performance tuning, and complex ETL/ELT pipeline optimization. Proficiency in modern workflow orchestration and transformation tools, specifically Airflow and dbt (Data Build Tool), to manage, schedule, and test complex data pipelines. Proven ability to solve complex data problems and partner effectively with Engineering, Analytics/BI, Product, and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in data migration projects, dependency mapping, cutover strategy, dual-running, reconciliation, and decommissioning. Experienced in developing cost-saving strategies for AWS Databricks, GCP BigQuery and Tableau Experience in OTA, travel tech, e-commerce, marketplace, fintech, or other high-volume transactional environments. Experience in one or more of: data warehouse architecture, large-scale data migration/pipeline consolidation, or analytics enablement. Exposure to CDC, streaming, semantic/metrics layers, or advanced data modelling. Experience leading technical designs, setting engineering standards, or mentoring other Data Engineers.

description:

Every day, our staff – of all ages and from all walks of life – work to bridge the gaps in community needs by nurturing the potential of youth and teens, improving our community’s health and well-being, and providing support to our neighbors, by serving others, building strong relationships, and incorporating our YMCA values into our everyday work.

POSITION SUMMARY:

This position supports the work of the Y, a leading nonprofit, charitable organization committed to strengthening community through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility. Under the supervision of the Youth Development Director, the Youth Development Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the Child Watch and Family Activity Center and providing exemplary member service, creating a friendly and courteous atmosphere for youth and families. In addition, the Youth Development Coordinator will act as the point person during operating hours, address staff and member concerns, supervise Child Watch and Family Activity Center staff, and reinforces policies in a professional and courteous manner.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  1. Directs the overall Child Watch, Youth Enrichment Programs and Family Activity Center operation, ensuring proper implementation of procedures and protocols with emphasis on exceptional service.

  4. Responsible for ensuring safety and supervision of youth and leading developmentally appropriate activities in the Child Watch and Family Activity Center.
  5. Recruit and hire Child Watch, Youth Enrichment and Family Activity Center staff, maintain training and development programs, reviews and evaluates staff performance, and develops strategies to motivate and retain staff, while ensuring appropriate staffing levels for regular shifts and substitute coverage.
  6. Maintains accurate and complete participant attendance logs within the program, also ensuring positive participant engagement.
  7. Ensures the Child Watch, Youth Enrichment Programs and the Family Activity Center have adequate supplies for operations, maintains program equipment, and makes recommendations for repairs.
  8. Assists the Youth Development Director in planning and executing special events, activities, and scheduling.
  9. Knows, reviews, and applies all safety, emergency, and child abuse prevention policies and procedures, responding to emergency situations in accordance with YMCA protocol.
  10. Participates as a member of assigned committees, attends regular staff meetings, and promotes the YMCA throughout the local community.
  11. Provides and welcomes ongoing dialogue with families about their child’s participation in activities, behaviors, and related topics, connecting families to the YMCA.
  12. Addresses member and staff concerns, providing exceptional member service and elevating issues to the Youth Development Director as appropriate.
  13. Perform additional responsibilities as assigned to support the mission and goals of the YMCA.

  • Displays strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Utilizes computer skills and has experience with standard business software.
  • Completion of YMCA Program-specific trainings upon hire
  • Ability to relate effectively to diverse groups of people from all social and economic segments of the community


WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to move the body through bending, leaning, kneeling, and walking.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to communicable diseases, thus engaging in frequent handwashing and us of disinfectant products
  • The employee is regularly required to remain stationary, upright, and alert for several hours at a time.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee must regularly interact with youth through oral comprehension and expression, as well as active listening and speech recognition
  • The employee is frequently required to lift and/or assist children up to 50 pounds in weight
  • The employee must occasionally lift and carry supplies weighing up to 20 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close and distance vision and the ability to adjust
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate

DIVERSITY STATEMENT

The YMCA of the Inland Northwest commits to being an inclusive organization for all. Driven by our mission and values of Caring, Honesty, Respect and Responsibility we actively work to close equity gaps for marginalized and underserved groups. We are inspired to elevate social justice issues facing our community, remove systemic barriers, welcome cultural diversity, and create equity for those in greatest need. Through collaboration with our diverse community partners together we work to effect meaningful change. In all things, we are dedicated to ensuring our Y is a safe, welcoming place for all people to be, belong, and become. The YMCA of the Inland Northwest provides Equal Employment Opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants.

The happiest and most fulfilled Y staff are motivated to help others and want to be a part of something larger than themselves. Join our team! Come be a part of a charitable, mission-driven organization that works for individual and community well-being for all, for a better us.
